Position Summary:

Monitor and operate plant equipment to maintain safe, efficient, and continuous plant operations.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Makes rounds and checks conditions of designated plant equipment; record operational data on log sheets. Completes assigned inspections.
  • Maintains safe and efficient operation of the Ash Handling System, other plant equipment.
  • Completes water testing and treatment. Evaluates and treats boilers, cooling, and other plant water systems. Operates demineralization system and maintains efficient demineralization system.
  • Operates auxiliary plant equipment locally, making necessary adjustments safety and efficiency. Operates and maintains lime slakers.
  • Assists the Plant Operator in the daily operation and maintenance of the plant from the field.
  • Conveys materials from storage or work sites to designated areas.
  • Secures lifting attachments to materials and conveys load to destination or signal crane or hoisting operators to move load to destination.
  • Counts, weighs, and records number of units of materials moved or managed on daily production sheet. Stacks or assembles materials into bundles and bands bundles together (where applicable).
  • Clamps sections of portable conveyor together or place conveyor sections on blocks or boxes to facilitate movement of materials or products. Lifts heavy objects by hand or with power hoist, and cleans work area, machines, and equipment to assist machine operators (where applicable).
  • Assemble crates to contain products such as machines or vehicles. Shovels lose materials such as sand, gravel, metals, plastics, or chemicals, into machine hoppers or into vehicles and containers such as wheelbarrows, scrap truck, or barrels.
  • Collects hazardous waste from satellite accumulation areas and other points of generation, delivers to hazardous waste 90-day accumulation area, notifies of any hazardous waste emergencies, notifies when drums are full.
  • Completes the Corporate and Plant Training Programs within the period prescribed.
  • Follow standard safety procedures, correct safety, and environmental hazards, and report them to the Shift Supervisor immediately. Reads, understands, and applies information such as, lockout/tagout procedures, safety rules, job hazard analyses, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Works overtime and rotating shifts.

Job Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) or equivalent.
  • Three or more months’ related experience and/or training.
  • Knowledge and skills to operate power plant auxiliary equipment, such as air compressors and dryers, hydraulic power units, forced draft fans, pumps, spray dryer and absorbers, and lime slakers.

The role will require a significant amount of interaction with internal and external stakeholders including executive level leadership.


In this role you will report to the Head of Technical Team C&I Storage and PV Turnkey Solutions.

  • Create, implement, and manage efficient commissioning processes for solar projects with the development of standardized processes and templates.

  • Develop an understanding for interfacing with the DNO/TNO and comply with its requirements.
  • Main point of contact during transition of projects from construction to operation, ensuring all equipment warranties have been assigned, all handover documentation is in place and ready to be provided to the owner, all the O&M staff received required training.

  • High proficiency in full suite of Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and PPT, MS Project, CRM systems, PowerBI, and other relevant software tools.



COMPETENCIES NEEDED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

title: Senior Quality Test Engineer I
description:
Summary

The Senior Quality Test Engineer I contributes to the development and execution of quality-driven, automation-first testing solutions, leveraging foundational AI-assisted testing capabilities.

This role emphasizes building a strong quality mindset, understanding risk-based testing, and supporting delivery teams in achieving reliable, high-quality releases.


Working closely with senior engineers, this role focuses on: Learning what to test and why, not just how, applying automation and AI tools to improve efficiency, and contributing to scalable and maintainable testing practices


The engineer plays a key role in transitioning from manual-heavy testing to intelligent, automation-assisted quality engineering.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

  • Contribute to quality assurance and automation-first testing practices for assigned components.
  • Develop and maintain: Test cases, Automated test scripts (UI/API), Basic performance tests
  • Use AI tools to: Generate test scenarios, Assist in writing test scripts and Improve productivity in test design
  • Learn to validate and refine AI-generated outputs.
  • Apply risk-based thinking to prioritize testing efforts.
  • Support maintenance and enhancement of test frameworks and automation suites.
  • Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas for improving test coverage and efficiency.

Operational Excellence

  • Execute automated and exploratory tests with a focus on quality outcomes, not just completion.
  • Support regression cycles using: Automation, AI-assisted test generation where applicable.
  • Review logs, monitoring data, and alerts to assist in issue identification and analysis.
  • Document defects clearly with context, impact, and reproducibility.
  • Assist in root cause analysis, learning to identify underlying issues.
  • Collaborate with developers to improve: Testability, Early defect detection (shift-left).
  • Provide feedback on: Test coverage gaps, Risk areas before release.

Product Delivery & Business Impact

  • Contribute to risk-based test planning aligned with feature requirements.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to: Clarify requirements, Ensure they are testable and complete.
  • Use AI tools to support: Test case generation, Test data preparation, Regression optimization.
  • Follow and contribute to standard automation and testing practices across teams.
  • Begin identifying what should be automated vs manually validated, based on guidance.
  • Ensure test scenarios cover: Functional requirements, Key edge cases, Basic user workflows.
  • Participate in improving overall product quality and testing efficiency.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Take ownership of assigned testing tasks and ensure quality deliverables.
  • Demonstrate a growing quality mindset by questioning requirements and identifying gaps.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members across QA, development, and product.
  • Share learnings in: Automation, AI tools, Testing practices.
  • Surface risks, blockers, and concerns early.
  • Communicate progress, issues, and test outcomes clearly.
  • Seek continuous improvement through learning and adoption of AI-driven practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Typically 6+ years QA with automation & performance testing skills, strong QA methodology understanding.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Strong understanding of: QA fundamentals, Software development lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated quality mindset with attention to detail and curiosity.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation (intermediate level).
  • Experience in using AI tools for testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt to evolving AI-enabled QA practices.


Skills

  • Developing competency in test automation tools: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Maestro (LMA only)
  • Understanding of: API testing, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for development/testing: Copilot, ChatGPT (or similar).
  • Ability to: Write and execute automated tests, Review AI-generated test scenarios with guidance.
  • Knowledge of: REST APIs, SQL/data validation.
  • Proficiency in: Logging, monitoring, and debugging, Performance and Security testing concepts Cloud fundamentals (AWS or similar) is a plus.

Building the infrastructure to power the world - we are Linxon! (youtube.com)

How will you make your impact?

As a Site Supervisor - Civil Works for Linxon, you play a critical role in the successful delivery of complex civil scope works by taking full ownership of on‑site execution from initial mobilization through final acceptance. You are the front‑line authority responsible for converting engineering intent into correctly built assets, ensuring schedule adherence, cost control through right‑first‑time execution, and elimination of rework. Acting firmly on behalf of Linxon, you lead daily construction activities, directly instruct contractors, enforce quality and compliance in real time, and resolve execution issues as they occur. Your impact is measured by safe, compliant, and high‑quality civil works delivered on schedule, with disciplined workmanship, complete documentation, and full alignment with approved designs, standards, and Linxon’s Quality Management System.

What will you do?

  • Direct and instruct contractor crews daily on the exact scope of work, execution methods, sequencing, and required quality standards

  • Translate approved drawings, method statements, and look‑ahead schedules into clear, actionable daily work plans

  • Ensure contractors fully understand drawings, tolerances, materials, workmanship, and interface requirements before execution

  • Coordinate manpower, equipment, materials, formwork, embeds, and work fronts to ensure full readiness prior to start of work

  • Monitor civil works continuously throughout the day and immediately correct deviations from approved plans or methods

  • Perform active quality control during execution, not only at completion, to prevent defects and rework

  • Complete and maintain all required daily quality documentation, including inspection checklists, ITP records, site reports, and verification of completed works

  • Identify non‑conformities early, enforce immediate corrective actions, and support timely NCR closure

  • Train and coach contractors on correct construction methods, LINXON quality expectations, civil codes, and professional site discipline

  • Enforce compliance with approved drawings, revisions, civil standards, and the LINXON Quality Management System

  • Stop work when quality, execution, or compliance requirements are not met and ensure safe execution in coordination with HSE

  • Coordinate daily with Construction Management, Engineering, and Quality teams and provide accurate progress and quality status updates

  • Support internal and external audits, inspections, and monthly quality reviews

Who you are?

  • You are an experienced Civil Site Supervisor with a proven track record on EPC, infrastructure, or industrial projects

  • You are hands‑on and execution‑driven, with strong capability in site supervision, quality control, and construction documentation

  • You are highly proficient in reading, explaining, and enforcing construction drawings, specifications, and method statements

  • You are knowledgeable in local and international civil construction codes, norms, and best practices

  • You are a confident on‑site authority, capable of directing contractors, correcting improper execution, and maintaining discipline

  • You are detail‑oriented and quality‑focused, with a strong commitment to delivering work right the first time

  • You are a reliable and professional leader with strong references from past construction projects

description:

You will join the feature squad. Together with developers, UX designers, and other specialists, you will shape and deliver innovative digital solutions for Business Banking customers. Your work will focus on enhancing existing capabilities, developing new Financial Health and Sustainability features for Web and App, and exploring opportunities for third-party partnerships and integrations that create additional customer value.

We combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. Collaboration, shared ownership, and continuous learning from customer feedback and data are at the heart of how we work.

As a Customer Journey Expert, you will translate customer and business needs into impactful digital solutions and continuously improve the digital customer experience.


  • Drive the development and optimisation of digital customer journeys across Web and App.

  • Translate insights into clear product requirements, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, UX designers, and stakeholders throughout discovery, delivery, and implementation.

  • Monitor journey performance and continuously improve customer experiences based on data and customer impact.
  • Explore new propositions, innovations, and third-party integration opportunities.
  • Contribute to delivering digital solutions that create measurable value for Business Banking customers.

How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

title: Testing Technologist I
description:
Job Description Summary

Under direct supervision at the Plasma Testing Laboratory, perform high complexity testing of laboratory samples assigned to the department in a fast-paced laboratory. Operate and maintain complex testing equipment. Document and report test results in compliance with departmental procedures while meeting established production demands. Perform all assigned tasks with a high degree of quality and proficiency, all while providing appropriate documentation following CLIA, FDA, EMA, etc. regulatory requirements in a GMP environment. Receives specific direction from supervisor and performs work under the general direction of a technical supervisor.


Job Description

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties and responsibilities regularly performed by and assigned to Testing Technologist levels I, II, and III:

  • Accurately and consistently performs assigned laboratory test procedures as outlined in established standard operating procedures.
  • Uses proper techniques for sample handling and processing to ensure the validity of test results.
  • Conserves laboratory resources by using equipment and supplies as needed to accomplish job results.
  • Ensures training qualifications for independent testing are current and accurate.
  • Learns complex concepts, technical specifications, and written procedures utilizing a combination of self-paced and hands-on training techniques.
  • Adheres to the laboratory's quality control policies: processes controls at defined intervals; evaluates control results; takes appropriate actions to resolve failures, and accurately documents all quality control activities.
  • Performs instrument calibrations and maintenance according to established schedules and procedures; verifies successful completion prior to testing.
  • Accurately identifies problems that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results.
  • Maintains technical knowledge of complex automated testing equipment to resolve instrument and analytical errors or testing inconsistencies.
  • Reviews test result data for accuracy and compliance to standard operating procedures and regulatory standards prior to release.
  • Recognizes invalid test results, takes appropriate corrective action, and documents all findings.
  • Follows cGMP regulations and laboratory policies on material handling; make sure reagents/test kits have received dates, expiration dates, and if applicable opened dates.
  • Inspects, takes inventory, and stores reagents and supplies when needed. Verifies material expiration dates and takes appropriate actions to limit waste.
  • Follows GMP for documentation using ALCOA; ensures that regulations pertaining to records, reports, and data integrity policies are met.
  • Documents all errors and corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the laboratory's established performance specifications.
  • Works as a member of a team responsible for completing the Plasma Testing Laboratory daily workload.
  • Works efficiently to consistently complete heavy workloads while maintaining all quality and safety standards.
  • Disinfects work areas and empty biohazardous waste.
  • Follows CLIA, FDA, EMA, and safety guidelines as described in their respective guidelines.
  • Maintains donor confidence and protects the company by keeping information confidential.
  • Performs all other duties, at the discretion of management, as assigned.
  • Works periodic over-time, holidays, or weekends as needed.

Additional duties and responsibilities regularly performed by and assigned to Testing Technologist levels II and III:

  • Performs maintenance tasks on all testing assays and instruments within the assigned department.
  • Performs daily checks and monthly review of maintenance logs.
  • Logs and tracks operations key performance indicators and provides data to management.
  • Supports less experienced testing personnel with resolving technical problems in accordance with laboratory policies and procedures.
  • Maintains instrumentation in validated state, tag out and re-qualify instruments when required.
  • Identifies and resolves instrument errors, and testing inconsistencies. Escalates problems/delays appropriately.
  • Manages result transmission including review and investigation resolution.
  • Ensures the department is maintained in a clean and organized manner including proper, sample material and supply storage.
  • Verifies and documents acceptable performance of critical testing supplies prior to production use.
  • Serves as a resource for corrections and clarification.
  • As appropriately delegated laboratory leadership:
    • Assists with training staff when the trainer or lead is unavailable.
    • Assists with organizing and executing comparison studies, blind sample testing challenges, and linearity verifications.
    • Aids new processes/instrumentation implementation by executing verifications and validations.

Additional duties and responsibilities regularly performed by and assigned to Testing Technologist level IIIs:

  • Provides subject matter expertise within the department and reviews procedures to ensure compliance.
  • Supports the development of new processes by reviewing validations drafts and standard operating procedures.
  • Initiates service calls for instrument repairs, coordinates repairs with field services, and assesses re-qualification.
  • Performs technical operations review of source testing documentation when needed.
  • Documents and investigates incidents of missed maintenance and failed/aborted tests.
  • Reviews and approves sample suitability records including sample cancellations.
  • Investigates issues related to turnaround time deviations, reactive rates, and instrument failure rates.
  • Reviews equipment service reports and accurately identifies the appropriate re-qualification steps to be performed.
  • As appropriately delegated laboratory leadership:
    • Assists with monitoring laboratory environmental system by addressing and documenting temperature and humidity deviations, may require weekend on-call duties.
    • Assists with communicating causes for result invalidation and ensuring proper corrective actions and approvals occur prior to retesting.
    • Serves as a primary resource for performing instrument and assay validations.
    • When necessary, cross trains in other departments’ processes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Biology or Chemistry required, or science related degree where education and training meet CFR 493.1489.
  • CLIA requirements for High Complexity Testing required.
  • California testing requirements where required by law or SOP.
  • Appropriate state licensure and/or certificate, where applicable, required.
  • Must possess High Complexity Testing competencies required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), CLIA, and other applicable regulatory and accrediting bodies required.

  • Additional Testing Technologist II Qualifications:
    • Must possess at least two (2) years of laboratory experience in high complexity testing.
    • Must meet the standard for General Supervisor, outlined in 42CFR493.1461.
    • Must possess demonstrated advanced laboratory knowledge and competency in laboratory SOPs and policies to perform job responsibilities.
    • Must possess competency on all testing assays and instrument maintenance tasks in assigned department.
  • Additional Testing Technologist III Qualifications:
    • Must have at least four (4) years of laboratory experience in high complexity testing.
    • Must meet the Standard for Technical Supervisor outlined in 42 CFR 493.1449.
    • Must be competent on use and maintenance of all instrumentation in assigned shift/department.
    • Must possess demonstrated advanced laboratory knowledge and competency in laboratory SOPs and policies to perform job responsibilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Certification as a Medical Technologist (MT)/Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS), Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) or Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT), Clinical Laboratory Technician (CLT) or equivalent preferred.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Must have knowledge of dilutions, ratios, and other basic laboratory math. Strong organization skills and legible handwriting are essential.
  • Must speak, read, and write English.
  • Must have the ability to apply rational thinking and understanding to carry out detailed written and/or oral instructions, and the capacity to identify and troubleshoot problems within regulatory guidelines and standard operating procedures.

PHYSICAL & TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Lab work environment: Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms. Exposure to extreme cold ( ≤ -20⁰C), miscellaneous production chemicals, moving machinery and production equipment. Exposure to high levels of noise on the production floor. Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.
  • 5+ hours per shift: Sitting, standing, handling. finger dexterity, pinching
  • 3- 5 hours per shift: Lifting to 20 pounds
  • Up to 3 hours per shift: Walking, climbing, bending, squatting, reaching above shoulders, reaching waist to shoulder, reaching knee to waist, reaching floor to knee, grasping items, carrying/move items up to 40 pounds
  • Travel: <5%

INTERNAL ADVANCEMENT STATEMENT

In order to be considered for advancement to the next Testing Technologist level, employees must possess the required qualifications, skills, and abilities as stated in the job description AND regularly demonstrate the qualities and behaviors commensurate with our CTS mission, vision, and values.

The job description reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified and shall not necessarily be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be inherent in the job. title: Sr. Director - Aesthetic Health External Innovation
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


At Lilly, we serve an extraordinary purpose. We make a difference for people around the globe by discovering, developing and delivering medicines that help them live longer, healthier, more active lives. Not only do we deliver breakthrough medications, but you also can count on us to develop creative solutions to support communities through philanthropy and volunteerism.


Aesthetic Health is an emerging and strategically important area at Lilly, sitting at the intersection of immunology, dermatology, and metabolic medicine. With a growing portfolio and a patient population increasingly searching for visible health solutions, external innovation will be central to building a differentiated, science-driven aesthetic medicine capability.


Purpose of the Job

Reporting to the SVP, Immunology Research, and working in close partnership with Corporate BD, Catalyze360, Aesthetic Health Strategy and Discovery colleagues, the Executive Director, Aesthetic Health External Innovation role provides search and evaluate activities for external and academic programs in aesthetic medicine — identifying, evaluating, and executing transformative partnerships across cutaneous biology, body contouring, skin aging, hair biology, and adjacent aesthetic indications.


This role serves as the primary scientific interface between Lilly's internal aesthetic health strategy and the external innovation ecosystem, ensuring that the most compelling external science is identified early and licensed or acquired with appropriate urgency to meet our Aesthetic Health strategic objectives. The successful candidate will combine deep mechanistic expertise with strategic judgment, relationship breadth, and an ability to operate effectively across scientific, clinical, commercial, and financial stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Source, identify, and coordinate evaluation of innovative external assets for Aesthetic Health, spanning the full range of modalities — from biologics and small molecules to devices and device-drug combinations, and novel delivery platforms — with a focus on differentiated and non-obvious solutions that can reshape the treatment landscape
  • Drive deals to completioncompletion: this role is expected to directly in-source programs into Lilly's Aesthetic Health portfolio (working with corporate business development and other functions), and the ability to align internal stakeholders, build consensus, and close transactions is a core expectation
  • Build long-term trusted relationships and serve as Lilly Aesthetic Health's representative with external partners, investment groups, and academic innovators, as well as internal peers and collaborators across Aesthetic Health and discovery, development, and commercial functions
  • Actively engage and examine the global innovation ecosystem — including emerging biotechs, medical device companies, academic spinouts, and adjacent consumer health innovators — for partnering, licensing, and acquisition possibilities that augment Lilly's Aesthetic Health capabilities and pipeline
  • Lead interactions with selected external organizations; represent Lilly's aesthetic strategy, scientific standards, and commercial needs to external partners with clarity and credibility
  • Execute key projects in collaboration with external groups, including design and oversight of de-risking experiments that build confidence and accelerate internal decision-making
  • Map the external competitive and innovation landscape continuously; cultivate relationships and platforms in emerging aesthetic categories or progressive technologies that could shift treatment paradigms and open new-to-Lilly spaces
  • Work closely with peers across affiliates and functions to ensure coordination of efforts, avoid duplication, and deliver consistent communications to senior leadership
  • Conduct rigorous analyses to support prioritization and indication planning decisions; develop scalable frameworks and processes for evaluating new targets, programs, and platform technologies within Aesthetic Health

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Dermatology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Cutaneous Biology, or a related field; M.D. with specialization in Dermatology, Plastic Surgery, or related field
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated expertise across the drug discovery and development lifecycle.
  • Proven track record in external innovation, search and evaluation, and/or business development within dermatology, aesthetic medicine, or an adjacent therapeutic area.
  • Deep mechanistic understanding of cutaneous biology, skin aging, and/or hair follicle biology, including familiarity with emerging therapeutic modalities and local delivery approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex scientific collaborations across organizational boundaries.
  • Strong strategic thinking capabilities with the ability to assess scientific merit and commercial potential of early-stage opportunities.

Additional Preferences

  • Experience in new company creation, venture capital interactions, or spinout management.
  • Track record of successful partnership execution — deal sheet preferred.
  • National and international collaboration experience; existing KOL network in dermatology and/or aesthetic medicine.
  • Familiarity with novel therapeutic modalities relevant to aesthetics, including cell therapy, genetic medicine, precision medicine, local delivery technologies, and device combinations.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leadership and drive strategic decision-making without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present compellingly to senior leadership and external partners.
  • Willingness to engage in domestic and international travel (up to 40%) to support partnership activities and external engagement.
  • Track record of managing and developing high-performing teams.

Physical Demands / Travel

The physical demands of this job are consistent with office-based work with frequent travel for partnership meetings, conferences, and diligence visits. Up to 40% domestic and international travel may be required to support partnership development and external collaboration activities.

title: Senior Research Fellow, Formulation Development
description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team, fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
Site:

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Research Fellow, Formulation Development is responsible for leading and directing formulation development and clinical supply manufacturing activities that support PTC’s drug discovery and clinical development programs. This involves preclinical and clinical formulation design and selection, preformulation characterization, process development and scale up and managing external service providers for formulation development and manufacturing.

The Senior Research Fellow, Formulation Development manages and/or oversees internal and external resources to address PTC’s formulation development and manufacturing requirements and related business needs. This includes accountability for ensuring the timely and successful development and manufacture of phase-appropriate formulations. Additional responsibilities include drug product process scale up, technical transfers and planning of manufacturing-related activities.

The incumbent works cross-functionally and serves as the primary liaison between the Formulation team, other PTC departments, external service providers and contract manufacturers on formulation related issues.

This individual also authors and reviews technical documents included in various regulatory submissions.

She/He may have direct reports.

The Senior Research Fellow, Formulation Development ensures adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
.

Job Description:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


Primary duties/responsibilities:

  • Develops robust formulations and manufacturing processes for Phase I-III clinical studies and assists in their transfer to Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).
  • Designs studies and conducts risk assessments as per target product profiles to build in quality-by-design (QbD) during formulation and process development.
  • Conducts process scale up and optimization studies using various QbD tools including design of experiments (DoE) and other modeling and scale-up tools. Supports formulation and process technology transfers and scale up to commercial manufacturing sites.
  • Conducts troubleshooting of formulation & processing related challenges and recommends potential solutions.
  • Develops alternate formulations for current commercial products through life cycle management as required.
  • Collaborates with PTC's cross-functional working groups and plays a lead role in addressing formulation needs for preclinical and clinical studies and establishing the strategy and development plan for preformulation, formulation, and process development activities. Leverages knowledge of physical pharmacy, biopharmaceutics, formulation and process design, drug delivery technologies where applicable.
  • Establishes the formulation strategy and development plan for preformulation and formulation activities for dosage form development in close collaboration with Clinical, Regulatory, Process Chemistry, Analytical, Project Management and other PTC groups. Leverages knowledge of traditional and enabling drug delivery technologies where applicable.
  • Directs and provides technical guidance and oversees formulation activities to support drug discovery and clinical programs, provides developability input in the selection of drug candidates, troubleshoots formulation & process related issues for drug products.
  • Evaluates third party service providers for formulation development and provides input towards their selection as necessary. Collaborates with Business Development, Legal and Quality and facilitates the execution of service agreements. Serves as the primary liaison with formulation development and contract manufacturing sites and with internal and external Quality Assurance groups for assigned projects.
  • Collaborates with CMOs and other outsourced partners to transfer manufacturing processes for drug product and to monitor cGMP batch manufacture.
  • Works with Clinical Supplies group to plan manufacturing campaigns for drug product.
  • May manage, coach and mentor direct reports.
  • Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES REQUIRED

* Minimum level of education and years of relevant work experience.

  • PhD degree in a relevant scientific discipline and a minimum of 8 years progressively responsible experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related environment OR a Master’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline and a minimum of 10 years progressively responsible experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related environment.

* Special knowledge or skills needed and/or licenses or certificates required.

  • Strong understanding of physical pharmacy, biopharmaceutics, drug delivery technologies and experience in the formulation development of small molecules including oral dosage forms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in oral dosage form (e.g., tablet, capsule, solution) manufacturing and scale up.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of cGMP.
  • Proven problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver presentations to senior management on the current status of projects and at internal and external technical meetings on formulation-related technologies and trends, as required.
  • Ability to influence without authority.
  • If managing direct reports, demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching and mentoring direct reports.
  • Provides support as needed for regulatory submissions or responses.
  • Manages the general safe working conditions in the laboratories.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
  • Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.

  • Experience managing and developing one or more direct reports.
  • Experience using electronic lab notebook.
  • Experience in formulation support work for Drug Discovery, Clinical Development, & Commercialization.
  • Track record of authorship of pertinent sections of successful regulatory submissions (INDs, CTAs, NDAs, Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDAs), MAAs, Investigational Medicinal Product Dossiers (IMPDs)) leading to the commercialization of drug products.
  • Experience providing responses to questions from health authorities with respect to regulatory submissions.
  • Ability to work cross functionally (internally and externally) on strategic, tactical and technical matters.

* Travel requirements

  • 10-15%

*Physical requirements

  • Office/laboratory-based position

Expected Base Salary Range: $190,700 – $240,0200. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.

title: Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach - EOI (Central East)
description:
We are on a mission to be the partner of choice for developing people and their communities. Reed Wellbeing is a public service provider delivering lifestyle and wellbeing programmes that help people improve their health.

Pay Range

£50 per 90 Minute session.

Job Description

Are you passionate about helping people to lead healthier lives?

Are you an enthusiastic, experienced health professional, looking for a flexible & highly rewarding role?

Then consider joining Reed Wellbeing as a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach!

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

This role will deliver across one or more programmes that make up the NHS Healthier You service. These programmes include the Diabetes Prevention Programme (DPP), Type 2 Diabetes Pathway to Remission Programme (T2DR), Behavioural Support for Obesity Prescribing Programme (BSOP) and Long-Term Conditions Prevention Pilot (LTCP).

As a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach, you will be responsible for the engagement and delivery of sessions in both group and/or one-to-one settings with participants.

Sessions are delivered face-to-face across the Central East Region, therefore flexibility and a willingness to travel are essential. Applicants must also have access to their own vehicle and hold a full UK driving licence.

Expected availability for programme delivery is between 12 and 20 hours per week. In return, you will receive £50 per 90 Minute session.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver engaging NHS Healthier You Programme sessions to participants in a group and/or one-to-one setting, in accordance with our curriculum, resources and quality standards.
  • Motivate, support, and empower participants to make sustainable lifestyle and behaviour changes, using evidence-based coaching techniques to improve their overall health and wellbeing.
  • Adapt session delivery to meet the diverse needs, abilities, and learning styles of participants, and create a positive and inclusive environment to encourage participation.
  • Monitor participant progress, conduct regular revies, and celebrate achievements while identifying additional support needs.
  • Signpost participants to appropriate local health, wellbeing and lifestyle support services where required.
  • Participate in training, professional development, and quality improvement activities to ensure the highest standards of service delivery.
  • Contribute ideas and feedback to support continuous improvement of programme delivery and participant outcomes.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Qualifications:

  • Minimum Level 3 Level 3 qualification in Exercise Referral, Health Improvement/Promotion/Public Health, Nutrition & Weight Management, Coaching & Behaviour Change, or Education & Training.
  • Evidence of training, qualification, or assessed competence in behaviour change delivery, aligned with recognised frameworks (e.g. COM‑B, Behaviour Change Wheel, motivational interviewing or health coaching approaches).
  • Fully First Aid trained, with a valid certificate.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Experience facilitating groups and supporting individuals to achieve positive health, lifestyle, or behaviour changes.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a person-centred and non-judgemental approach.
  • Ability to engage and motivate people from diverse backgrounds and with varying levels of confidence and health literacy.
  • Demonstrable IT skills, including the ability to confidently use digital platforms and systems to deliver services, record data, and meet reporting requirements.
  • Willingness to participate in induction, supervision, observed practice, competency assessment and ongoing CPD including all mandatory core training.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as required, and the ability to travel throughout the designated region using your own vehicle.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Experience delivering behaviour change programmes aligned with NHS‑commissioned or public health services.
  • Experience working with individuals and/or groups with additional needs, long-term health conditions, obesity, or pre-diabetes.
  • Fluency in multiple languages.
  • Experience supporting service users via digital or remote delivery platforms.
  • Qualification in group-based delivery.
  • Level 3 Qualification in British Sign Language.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Technical Program Manager

Job Description

You were made to do this work: exploring uncharted questions, engineering innovative solutions, advancing scientific understanding, and constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to solving real-world problems with purpose and precision. You want to work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development. In this role, you’ll help us shape the future and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead complex, cross‑functional product development programs for our dispenser and smart/IoT solutions portfolio.
  • Own programs from concept through launch and post‑launch optimization, bringing together internal and external development teams to deliver differentiated, high‑quality products on time and within scope.
  • Coordinate work across hardware, firmware, software, and operations, manage risks and tradeoffs, and keep stakeholders aligned through clear communication and strong program leadership.
  • Report to the Senior R&D Manager – Dispensers and be based in Roswell, GA.
  • Lead end‑to‑ end product development programs from concept through launch, including post‑launch optimization of dispensing systems and smart/IoT‑based solutions.
  • Coordinate internal and external teams across hardware, firmware, software, and operations to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Collaborate, lead and coach vendor partners throughout product development, go-live, and post launch lifecycles.
  • Build and maintain integrated timelines and plans, making informed tradeoffs on scope, schedule, resources, and cost while maintaining quality.
  • Run the core program routines (planning, standups, reviews, gate meetings) and track progress against clear goals and milestones.
  • Identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies, driving mitigation plans and timely decisions.
  • Ensure products meet agreed performance, quality, safety, regulatory, and launch‑readiness expectations.
  • Provide clear, concise status updates and recommendations to leadership and cross‑functional partners.
  • Capture lessons learned and improved “Ways of working” across future product programs.
  • Document and help protect intellectual property generated through development activities.

About Us

Huggies®. Kleenex®. Cottonelle®. Scott®. Kotex®. Poise®. Depend®. Kimberly-Clark Professional®. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. In fact, millions of people use Kimberly-Clark products every day. We know these amazing Kimberly-Clark products wouldn’t exist without talented professionals, like you.

At Kimberly-Clark, you’ll be part of the best team committed to driving innovation, growth and impact. We’re founded on more than 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly-Clark.

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.

About You

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.

You love what you do, especially when the work you do makes a difference. At Kimberly-Clark, we’re constantly exploring new ideas on how, when, and where we can best achieve results.

In one of our manufacturing roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a relevant engineering discipline from an accredited college or university.
  • 7+ of experience in a variety of technical assignments, including leading complex product development efforts.
  • Proven track record of delivering new electro‑mechanical products or major product renovations from concept through launch.
  • Experience with design and commercialization activities related to:
    • Plastics and injection molding.
    • Electro‑mechanical systems.
    • Low‑power, battery‑operated devices.
  • Experience with design controls, design verification/validation, and change management processes.
  • Strong proficiency with program and project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum, stage‑gate, or hybrid) and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
  • Demonstrated ability to:
    • Build and manage multi‑release product roadmaps and integrated project plans.
    • Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across multiple teams and vendors.
    • Communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong influence and collaboration skills, with experience leading without direct authority in a matrixed environment.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in technical field or business.
  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • IoT / connected devices, smart products, or systems integrating hardware, firmware, and cloud services.
    • Consumer or B2B product development in regulated or quality‑critical environments.
    • Enterprise SaaS or data/analytics platforms associated with physical products.
  • Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated success setting up and running program governance, including steering committees and cross‑functional operating mechanisms.
  • Customer‑facing technical support experience (e.g., working directly with customers or field teams to resolve technical issues).

Total Benefits

Here are just a few of the benefits you’d enjoy working in this role for Kimberly-Clark. For a complete overview, see .

Great support for good health with medical, dental, and vision coverage options with no waiting periods or pre-existing condition restrictions. Access to an on-site fitness center, occupational health nurse, and allowances for high-quality safety equipment.

Flexible Savings and spending accounts to maximize health care options and stretch dollars when caring for yourself or dependents.

Diverse income protection insurance options to protect yourself and your family in case of illness, injury, or other unexpected events.

Additional programs and support to continue your education, adopt a child, relocate, or even find temporary childcare.

To Be Considered
Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.

In the meantime, please check out the careers website.

And finally, the fine print….

For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. title: Senior Director, Content & Creative
description:
Overview

Concentra is recognized as the nation’s leading occupational health care company.With more than 40 years of experience, Concentra is dedicated to our mission to improve the health of America’s workforce, one patient at a time. With a wide range of services and proactive approaches to care, Concentra colleagues provide exceptional service to employers and exceptional care to their employees.

The Senior Director, Content & Creative leads Concentra's content and creative strategy and execution, transforming marketing strategies and business priorities into compelling communications and experiences that strengthen the organization's reputation, build brand awareness and support business growth.

This role owns the content and creative strategy from strategy through execution – setting the vision, editorial direction, and creative strategy, establishing the vision, standards, and operating model for how Concentra tells its story across the enterprise. The Senior Director leads a multidisciplinary team and is responsible for advancing business priorities and differentiating the Concentra brand. Working closely with the Vice President, Marketing & Communications, this leader partners across Product, Digital, Revenue Operations, Sales, Clinical and Operations to develop and execute integrated content and creative strategies, elevate the Concentra brand and continuously enhance the organization's content and creative capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of integrated content strategies that strengthen Concentra's reputation, build brand awareness, increase customer engagement and support enterprise growth initiatives.
  • Lead the creative function from strategy through execution providing strategic creative direction, coaching writers and designers, and ensuring all deliverables reflect Concentra's brand standards, quality and impact expectations.
  • Champion and operationalize Concentra's brand strategy, ensuring consistent application of brand standards, messaging architecture, editorial quality and visual identity across all external marketing communications.
  • Partner with business, clinical and commercial leaders to translate enterprise priorities into integrated content, creative and communications strategies that support customer acquisition, customer engagement, retention and business growth.
  • Develop compelling content, including thought leadership, executive presentations, customer stories, case studies, testimonials, news announcements, media materials, sales enablement materials, website content, campaign assets, videos and other external communications.
  • Lead and continuously evolve the content and creative operating model, including editorial planning, project management, intake, prioritization, resource allocation and production workflows to ensure efficient, high-quality delivery.
  • Establish and continuously improve content operations, governance, measurement frameworks and creative workflows by implementing best practices and leveraging AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency while maintaining editorial and creative excellence.
  • Establish key performance indicators and success measures to evaluate content effectiveness, campaign engagement and creative impact, using insights to continuously optimize strategy and execution.
  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing content and creative team while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent education and experience
  • In lieu of higher education, the ratio is 1:1 meaning one year of college equals one year of work experience and vice-versa.

title: Butikkmedarbeider
description:
Motiveres du av å skape gode kundeopplevelser, jobbe med salg og bruke ditt kreative blikk?

Til vår butikk på Sandvika søker vi en butikkmedarbeider med godt humør som har interesse for salg og bildeprodukter til en 36,6% fast stilling.


Kvalifikasjoner og profil

Vi ser etter deg som har interesse for bilder, interiør og kreative produkter, og som synes det er gøy å hjelpe andre med å finne løsninger som betyr noe for dem.


Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg eller service, men det er ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et genuint engasjement, en positiv innstilling og et ønske om å lære og utvikle deg. Har du interesse for våre produkter og et ønske om å gjøre en forskjell for kundene våre, tror vi du vil passe godt inn hos oss.


Arbeidsoppgaver

CEWE Japan Photo Sandvika er en rendyrket bildebutikk som spesialiserer seg på våre prisvinnende produkter. Her hjelper vi våre kunder med CEWE FOTOBOK, dekorere veggene med egne bilder eller å lage fotogaver til sine kjære.

Arbeidet vil bestå i å yte topp service og å selge fotoprodukter som vår prisvinnende CEWE FOTOBOK, CEWE veggbilder (bildeforstørrelser, lerret, akryltrykk), rammer, bilder og andre fotoprodukter så interesse for interiør og bilder er en fordel.

Har du prøvd å lage en CEWE fotobok selv og kunne tenke deg å hjelpe andre med å få noe ut av deres digitale bilder og gi gleden av produktene videre?

Vi håper du ønsker å bidra til at flotte blinkskudd ikke blir liggende på mobilen eller bortgjemt på en harddisk. Vi tror at ett bilde på veggen er bedre enn 10 på mobilen, og at gode minner gjør seg aller best i en personlig og unik CEWE FOTOBOK.

Vi tilbyr

  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer
  • Mulighet for videre utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter
  • Gode personalrabatter på våre produkter
  • Spennende produkter i Nordens ledende kjede innenfor fotoutstyr og bildeprodukter
  • Lønn etter avtale

Oppstart: oktober



CEWE-merket har siden 1961 stått for innovasjon, kreativitet og fotoprodukter av høy kvalitet som begeistrer mennesker over hele Europa.

Klar til å ta neste steg? Vi gleder oss til å høre din historie.

Bli med i teamet vårt og form fremtiden sammen med oss

title: Software/ Hardware Integration Engineer - Submarines
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Software/ Hardware Integration Engineer - Submarines

Working Pattern: Mon-Fri, 37 hours, days (Full time)

Working location: Glasgow (Onsite role)


An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Software/Hardware Integration Engineer to join the Dreadnought team based in Glasgow. Working as part of this high-profile engineering programme, you will play a key role in the integration, verification and validation of complex systems, bringing together software, FPGA and hardware components.


As a Software/Hardware Integration Engineer, you will be responsible for validating complex sub-systems and ensuring the timely delivery and quality of the artefacts associated with system integration, verification and validation. You will work closely with a range of engineering teams to support the successful delivery of robust and effective solutions.



What you will be doing:

  • Develop test documentation, including test plans, procedures, reports and automated test scripts.
  • Develop test equipment solutions and conduct Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) level testing across a range of functionality and environmental tests.
  • Develop automated testing procedures for FPGA designs and support detailed integration testing against DOORS requirements.
  • Conduct failure investigations and root cause analysis, applying structured problem-solving techniques.
  • Ensure adherence to change control, configuration management and established development processes, demonstrating solution correctness and traceability to design requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing cost and timescales while improving quality.
  • Support process and technical audits, product design reviews and verification activities.
  • Liaise closely with software, systems, hardware, programmable hardware (FPGA) and safety teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Qualified to degree level, In Software or Electronics Engineering, or related discipline,
  • Experience with field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA)
  • Experienced in integrating complex electronic products, fault finding and diagnosis.
  • Experienced in one of digital electronics design and verification, programmable logic device design and verification, software design and verification or real-time systems, and awareness of the others.
  • Self-motivated and enthusiastic to become familiar with new techniques and tools,
  • Awareness of safety-critical development constraints (e.g. IEC62566).
  • Experienced in timing analysis.

Regional Benefits:

  • Generous Annual Leave
  • Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
  • Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
  • Digital GP provides a convenient way for you to access GP consultations
  • Employee Assistance (EAP) and Live Well programmes

Please be aware that the priority will be given to employees identified as being at high risk.


The professional level and the salary of the position will be dependent on the skills and experience of the successful candidate.

It is advised that you inform your current manager of your application for this role.


To work for the Rolls-Royce Defence business an individual has to hold a Security Check clearance. Rolls-Royce will support the application for Security Clearance if you do not currently already have this in place. Due to the nature of work the business conducts and the protection of certain assets we can only progress applications from individuals who are a UK national or, in MoD approved cases, a dual national.


Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.


Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive

title: Customer Solutions Coordinator
description:
About Us


At Aussie Broadband, things are done a little bit differently. Our goal is to be the telco people love – customers, team members, shareholders and all stakeholders. We do this by living and breathing our values in everything we do, that's the Aussie way. As a B Corp Certified company, we hold ourselves to the highest standards for social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability. We're proud to have been named one of Australia's Top Employers by HRD magazine.


Listed on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX: ABB), the Aussie Broadband Group collectively supplies more than 1 million telecommunications services, operates two Tier 1 voice providers in Australia and owns fibre infrastructure.


Our culture is built on five values that guide everything we do:


Don't be ordinary, be awesome | Think BIG | No bullsh*t | Be good to people | Have fun



About the Role


As a Customer Solutions Coordinator, you'll be the key link between our customers and internal teams, ensuring every solution is delivered smoothly and with care. A strong background in telco voice and data services is essential, as you'll be coordinating voice-related customer solutions, managing service delivery activities, and acting as a trusted point of contact for customers and stakeholders.


This permanent role combines coordination, problem-solving, and relationship-building to create exceptional customer experiences. You'll manage contracts, oversee service delivery, and work closely with suppliers and partners to keep projects on track.


If you're organised, adaptable and customer focused, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a collaborative team.


What You'll Do


As a Customer Solutions Coordinator, you’ll play a key role in bringing our values to life by ensuring our customers feel supported and cared for every step of the way. You’ll work closely with customers, sales teams, and technical experts to make sure solutions are delivered seamlessly and with heart.

  • Coordinating customer solutions and ensuring successful delivery
  • Assisting with procurement and logistics to keep projects on track
  • Managing customer contracts and Service Level Agreements
  • Performing quality checks after implementation to maintain high standards
  • Responding to inbound calls and enquiries with empathy and clarity
  • Handling orders and liaising with management to resolve issues promptly
  • Working with wholesale suppliers to troubleshoot and resolve order challenges
  • Maintaining accurate records and data entry
  • Jumping in to help with other tasks as needed

What You'll Bring


You’re someone who thrives on collaboration and takes pride in creating positive experiences for others. You enjoy building strong relationships and have a natural ability to stay organised while juggling multiple priorities. You’re curious, adaptable, and love learning new things to help you grow and support your team.


  • A warm and approachable communication style with exceptional interpersonal skills
  • Proven experience delivering outstanding customer service (around three years)
  • Strong organisational and time management skills that keep things running smoothly
  • Ability to write clearly for different audiences
  • A knack for problem-solving and thinking proactively
  • Comfortable working on your own while contributing to a supportive team environment
  • Quick to learn and flexible when things change
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies
  • Knowledge of telco and data services is essential

Why Join Us


At Aussie Broadband, we celebrate difference and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their whole self to work. As a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, we support and celebrate diversity every day it's just one of the ways we live our value of "Be good to people."


We also give back to the communities we serve through our Pledge 1% commitment, community sponsorship programs, and paid community service leave for all staff.


The Good Stuff


  • 26 weeks paid parental leave for permanent employees, for both primary and secondary caregivers (in addition to any government-paid leave)
  • Discounted internet up to the value of $109 per month
  • 20% off Mobile services
  • Fitness Passport for access to multiple gyms and pools across Australia
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Discounts with Specsavers, HCF, and many more
  • Monthly rewards and recognition
  • Internal training and development resources to support your career growth
  • Yearly Aussie merch allowance

Ready to Join?


Hit the apply button to submit your application and our team will be in touch!


Even if you feel you don’t meet all the requirements, we’d still love to hear your story. We like to think outside the box with the people we hire.


For questions, reach out to careers@team.aussiebroadband.com.au. Just note that all applications must be submitted via the job link.

title: Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Operations Control Governance & Conformance
description:
Job Description:

Job Title Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Operations Control Governance & Conformance

Location London

Corporate Title Vice President

Deutsche Bank benefits from having a highly experienced and dedicated AFC function, which performs a crucial role in keeping Deutsche Bank’s business operations and global financial services clean from financial crime while serving the interests of the Bank and society. Our regional/global matrix structure allows for flexible responses to challenges in the core areas of: Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions & Embargoes, Anti-Fraud, Bribery & Corruption, Investigations & Intelligence, Monitoring & Screening, and Risk Assessment.

Our AFC Team will provide you with opportunities to learn, grow and define your career. We foster an open, diverse, and inclusive team culture, that is engaged and well-supported for prosperity and enjoyment of a life/work balance.

You will support in strengthening the control environment across AFC Operations by driving governance, conformance, audit readiness, issue remediation oversight and control effectiveness activities. The role will provide independent challenge, transparency and coordination across operational teams, helping ensure regulatory, policy and risk management expectations are consistently met while enabling sustainable operational improvement.

What we’ll offer you

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Hybrid Working - we understand that employee expectations and preferences are changing. We have implemented a model that enables eligible employees to work remotely for a part of their working time and reach a working pattern that works for them
  • Competitive salary and non-contributory pension
  • 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days
  • Life Assurance and Private Healthcare for you and your family
  • A range of flexible benefits including Retail Discounts, a Bike4Work scheme and Gym benefits
  • The opportunity to support a wide ranging CSR programme + 2 days’ volunteering leave per year

Your key responsibilities

  • Support the Control Governance & Conformance capability in defining, embedding and maintaining the AFC Operations control strategy and governance framework.
  • Support coordination of conformance reviews, audit and regulatory activities, providing consistent oversight across AFC Operations.
  • Provide independent challenge on control design and effectiveness, operational risks, issues, root causes and remediation priorities.
  • Establish management information, metrics and reporting that provide transparent views of control health, emerging risks and remediation delivery.
  • Facilitate governance forums covering audit actions, regulatory commitments, control issues and evidence of sustainable closure.
  • Partner together with capability leads and subject-matter experts to strengthen control execution, documentation, evidence management, accountability and continuous improvement.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience within Risk, Controls, Governance, Audit, Compliance or Financial Crime functions in financial services.
  • Practical experience overseeing operational control frameworks, control effectiveness assessments and conformance activities.
  • Proven track record coordinating audit, regulatory review, issue management and sustainable remediation in a highly regulated environment.
  • Ability to provide independent challenge, identify control weaknesses and risk themes, and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and root-cause assessment skills, with experience producing management information, assurance reporting and control-health assessments.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across complex, global organisations.

How we’ll support you

  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • We value diversity and as an equal opportunities’ employer, we make reasonable adjustments for those with a disability such as the provision of assistive equipment if required (e.g. screen readers, assistive hearing devices, adapted keyboards)

title: Mammo Technologist-PRN
description:
Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary


Grady Health System is seeking a PRN Mammography Technologist to perform advanced breast imaging procedures that support accurate diagnostic interpretation and high-quality patient care. This role is ideal for imaging professionals who are committed to delivering patient-centered care while supporting flexible departmental coverage needs.

The Mammography Technologist performs comprehensive breast imaging studies under the direction of a Radiologist, producing high-quality diagnostic images using specialized mammography equipment. In collaboration with radiologists and interdisciplinary healthcare teams, the technologist supports timely diagnosis and treatment planning while maintaining strict adherence to imaging protocols, radiation safety standards, and quality control procedures.

In this role, the Mammography Technologist provides patient care essential to breast imaging services while ensuring patient safety, comfort, and clear communication throughout imaging procedures. The technologist must demonstrate strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain efficient workflow within a high-volume imaging environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform mammography and breast imaging procedures in accordance with physician orders and established imaging protocols
  • Produce high-quality diagnostic images to support accurate clinical interpretation
  • Assist radiologists with image-guided diagnostic and invasive breast procedures as required
  • Monitor and support patient safety, comfort, and care throughout imaging procedures
  • Perform and document equipment quality control (QC) in accordance with departmental protocols and report equipment issues as necessary
  • Maintain accurate patient records, procedure documentation, and imaging data within departmental systems
  • Apply radiation safety practices, universal precautions, and sterile techniques to maintain a safe clinical environment
  • Support efficient patient flow and departmental operations
  • Provide instruction and guidance to radiology and ultrasound students rotating through the imaging modality

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Successful completion of a two-year Radiologic Technology program approved by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation (CAHEA) of the American Medical Association (AMA)
  • Certification in Radiologic Technology through the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT)

8. Continuous Improvement – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
9. Leadership & Professionalism – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.

At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our Total Rewards package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

Grady’s Total Rewards are designed to ensure our employees feel valued, supported, and empowered, both at work and beyond.

Why Join Grady?
Grady Health System is more than a hospital — we are a vital part of Atlanta and the surrounding communities. For over 125 years, Grady has been committed to providing exceptional care, advancing health equity, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve. When you join Grady, you become part of a team that values excellence, compassion, innovation, and collaboration.

title: Sterile Processing Technician
description:
Great people. Great careers.
Join the team at Great Plains Health, where you can be a part of something, well, great.

Job Title:

Central Sterile Technician

Cost Center:

Central Sterile

Job Description:

The Central Sterile Processing (CS) Technician is responsible for following infection control standards and manufacturer recommendations for cleaning, preparing, processing (inspection, assembling, and packaging), sterilizing, and storing medical/surgical supplies, equipment, implants and instruments required by medical, surgical, and nursing personnel for the care and treatment of patients.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Certified Registered Central Service Technician (CRCST) within 2 years of Date of Hire preferred.

Essential Functions 1. Knowledgeable of the flow process of central sterile processing. Performs functions and duties associated with the care, handling and sterilization of surgical instruments, implants, equipment and flexible endoscopes. 2. Disassembles, cleans and disinfects all instruments and equipment and supplies returned to the decontamination room for reprocessing. 3. Competently operates, maintains, cleans and loads washer/decontamination, ultrasonic machine, steam, SFPP, and Sterrad sterilizers, Cart Washer, and any other patient care equipment. 4.
