description:
Job Description

Production Controller

Solihull

Full time

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Position Summary

Working within an OBU, responsible for your defined portfolio of products, components or manufacturing area within the Planning & Control team, working closely with Production Leaders.

Responsible for driving adherence to the commitment accepted plan for internal and external customers whilst ensuring maintenance of MRP and supporting systems.

Working within an operational team identifying and prioritising delivery issues, escalating appropriately whilst assisting any mitigation and resolution of risks which would impact delivery and inventory performance.

Be the first point of contact with regards to delivery for the external or internal supply-chain.

Supporting the incorporation of new products by ensuring the plant is executing the agreed delivery plans.

What you will be doing:

  • Production Controlling - Working with the team to ensure adherence to the plan at machine level and use machine scheduling techniques to control production through the process in line with the customer expectation. Ensure the correct priority call is made when resource contention occurs
  • Ensuring that all planning systems used to control production planning are managed and maintained daily including inbound SUBCON / Supplier delivery commitments in line with the Rolls-Royce Production System.
  • Adherence against the agreed business plan in conjunction with the extended functional teams and in line with Rolls Royce Production System requirements. Where performance diverges from the plan, identify, mitigate and prioritise effective resolution. Ensure appropriate escalation of the delivery issues, mitigating actions and recovery plans.
  • This will be achieved using standard tools, processes and metric. Production Reporting - SMWIP, Production Order Adherence, Throughput Monitoring
  • SUBCON and Customer Management - Regular reviews and communication on delivery plans, measuring of SLA adherence and the escalation of issues when required
  • Material availability: Interface with the order controller for early identification and impact of possible shortages and excess affecting the business plan, to ensure mitigating actions are completed and escalate where appropriate.
  • 4 Weekly Planning - Continuously realign the short-term delivery plan in alignment with customer requirements liaising with the planner when appropriate.
  • Ensure that all planning systems are managed and maintained with all front-end actions are executed in a timely manner in line with the RRPS.
  • Exception Message management & ERP compliance review process.
  • Supports OBU critical delivery reviews through the supply of updated plans and commitments maintained in the executive system as agreed with the team.
  • Supports the provision of delivery commitments and action status through relevant PI executive tools and systems
  • Support the return of parts back to a supplier or plant, where non-conformance is identified.
  • Where required, liaise with in factory logistics team to ensure timely receipt and despatch of parts
  • Working with relevant stakeholders and third-party service providers support the resolution of all inbound delivery issues into CFBU or other plants including Stock in Transit, GRIP and NCR stock.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. They must be confident working with large and complex datasets, comfortable with creating and using advanced functions such as XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, and data validation.
  • Responsibilities will include extracting, analysing, manipulating, and presenting data to support business decision-making. The role requires excellent attention to detail, the ability to identify trends and anomalies within data, and experience producing accurate reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
  • Candidates should be comfortable handling high volumes of data, maintaining data integrity, and working to tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
  • Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
  • Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free! Rolls-Royce | Your Shares: Matched
  • Digital GP provides a convenient way for you to access GP consultations

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

title: Kersthulp Almere
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een leuke bijbaan tijdens de drukste en gezelligste periode van het jaar, waarin je veel contact hebt met mensen én werkt in een gezellig team? Dan hebben wij de perfecte uitdaging voor jou!

Als kerstkracht in onze boutique in Almere ben jij hét gezicht van My Jewellery tijdens de drukke feestdagen. Je verwelkomt klanten met energie, helpt ze bij het vinden van hun favoriete items en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen met een glimlach de winkel verlaat. Samen met je team creëer je een Boutique die straalt en uitnodigt. Van het aanvullen van de collectie tot het adviseren van klanten en het feestelijk inpakken van cadeautjes: jij zorgt voor een fijne en inspirerende winkelervaring.

Benieuwd hoe het is om in een van onze Boutiques te werken? Bekijk deze video!

Jouw taken als Kersthulp

Als Kerstkracht bij My Jewellery werk je tijdelijk in oktober, november en december in onze Boutique en bied je belangrijke ondersteuning tijdens de drukke periode rondom de feestdagen. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat alles op de winkelvloer soepel verloopt.

  • Je helpt en adviseert klanten bij het vinden van hun favoriete items;

  • Je zorgt voor een fijne winkelervaring en persoonlijke service;

  • Je pakt cadeautjes feestelijk in met zorg en aandacht;

  • Je houdt de boutique netjes en overzichtelijk;

  • Je ondersteunt je collega’s tijdens drukke momenten.

  • Je bent beschikbaar in oktober, november en december;

  • Je bent in het weekend minimaal één dag beschikbaar;

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar tijdens de drukke periode rondom de feestdagen;

  • Je werkt graag in een dynamische omgeving;

  • Je krijgt energie van klantcontact en helpt graag anderen;

  • Je hebt oog voor detail, bijvoorbeeld bij het mooi inpakken van cadeautjes;

  • Je woont in of nabij Almere.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

Job Description:

  • This is a Level II position.
  • Performs pre-analytical activities including equipment maintenance, function checks, inventory control, supply stocking, specimen collection, biological specimen processing, cleaning, and disinfection of laboratory equipment and spaces.
  • Conducts post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, including reporting results and providing technical support.

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  • Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the department or work area assigned [Required]

  • Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents [Required]
  • General knowledge of laboratory testing functions and equipment use [Required]
  • Critical thinking skills and attention to detail and accuracy [Required]
  • Proficient in verbal and written communication skills {Required]; additional languages [Preferred]
  • Strong analytical and mathematical abilities; excellent organization and people skills [Required]
  • Flexibility in scheduling of hours; may be required to work overtime, weekends, and holidays [Required]
  • Ability to read, write and follow instructions in English; good oral communication skills; excellent customer service skills [Required]
  • Mathematical, computer reasoning, and language skills at the college level (2 Must have proper communication skills to convey information effectively and problem-solving/decision-making skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and implement solutions [Required]
  • Ability to multitask and knowledge of basic state and federal laws as applicable to the laboratory setting [Required]
  • Ability to handle infectious biological specimens, caustics, toxic chemicals, and/or irritants appropriately and safely [Required]
  • Display a willingness and ability to learn and develop new techniques and procedures as needed for research protocol development [Required]
  • Proficiency in a wide variety of laboratory techniques in specimen preparation, ranging from making basic solutions and reagents, to performing more complex processes such as DNA/RNA extractions, stem cell isolations, and preparations for histological evaluations [Preferred]
  • Sound knowledge in a wide variety of laboratory and molecular assays and techniques [Preferred]


Education:

  • Bachelors [Required]


Field of Study:

  • In a chemical, biological, clinical or medical laboratory science or medical technology from an accredited institution; OR if the field of study does not match, candidate must meet the CLIA equivalency listed in additional information

Additional Information:

  • An equivalent combination of education and/or relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of the stated degree requirement:
  • Equivalent laboratory training and experience meeting the requirements defined in CLIA regulation 42CFR493.1489(b)(3)(ii): For high complexity testing, equivalent laboratory training and experience includes the following:
  • 60 semester hours or equivalent from an accredited institution that, at a minimum, includes either 24 semester hours of medical laboratory technology courses, OR
  • 24 semester hours of science courses that include six semester hours of chemistry, six semester hours of biology, and 12 semester hours of chemistry, biology or medical laboratory technology in any combination; AND
  • Laboratory training including either completion of a clinical laboratory training program approved or accredited by the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES) or the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP) (note that this training may be included in the 60 semester hours listed above), OR
  • At least three months documented laboratory training in each specialty in which the individual performs high complexity testing; OR
  • Successful completion of at least a 50-week official US military medical laboratory procedures training course and currently hold or have held the military enlisted occupational specialty of Medical Laboratory Specialist (Laboratory Technician); OR
  • Qualified and served as high complexity testing personnel in a CLIA-certified laboratory as of December 28, 2024, and have done so continuously since December 28, 2024.

title: Senior Data Quality Analyst
description:
At Ledgebrook, we are building an Excess & Surplus (E&S) lines insurance company that combines deep underwriting and pricing expertise with a modern tech platform fit for the future of insurance– truly a best of both worlds approach. Our speed and service underpin every decision we make, and our rapidly growing team is a testament to our value proposition resonating with the market. You bring the passion and entrepreneurial spirit, and we’ll provide the opportunity to unleash the very best of your talents and skills. Apply now to advance your career at Ledgebrook.

About the Role

Ledgebrook is seeking an experienced Senior/Data Quality Analyst to join our Product & Data team. On this team, you’ll lead analytical efforts to analyze complex data to ensure its integrity and accuracy. You will play a key role in driving organizational trust in reporting and analytics and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.

As a Senior/Data Quality Analyst, you will collaborate with engineering, data excellence, pricing and analytics, finance, and compliance teams to improve data quality. A key part of your role will be proactively querying databases, reviewing data and dashboards, understanding data flow processes, and supporting implementation of data initiatives.


What You'll Do:

  • Safeguard Data Quality – Conduct deep-dive data investigations to identify, trace, and resolve root-cause inconsistencies across actuarial, finance, and operational datasets.
  • Support Actuarial & Financial Reporting – Partner directly with actuarial and finance teams to validate data accuracy for reserving, modeling, and financial reporting needs.
  • Build Dashboards & Monitoring Tools – Design, develop, and maintain automated Power BI dashboards and SQL queries to continuously track data integrity and key performance metrics.
  • Optimize Workflows with AI & Automation – Integrate modern AI tools and automated pipelines into daily workflows to increase analytical efficiency and streamline reporting.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with Data Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to align data definitions, improve data models, and support system integrations (e.g., Workday/ERP).
  • Drive Data Precision in a High-Growth Setting – Take full ownership of data quality initiatives, navigating startup ambiguity to keep Ledgebrook operating with unmatched precision.

About you

About You:

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • Insurance & Actuarial Data Expertise: 3+ years of experience analyzing insurance data, specifically supporting actuarial (reserving/modeling) or insurance finance functions.
  • Strong Technical Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Excel, and Power BI for deep-dive analytical investigation, data modeling, and reporting.
  • Actuarial Background or Progress: Former actuarial experience or active progress on actuarial exams.
  • Root-Cause Data Investigation: Obsessive attention to detail with a relentless curiosity to investigate, trace, and resolve complex data inconsistencies.
  • Startup Ownership & Drive: Self-starter mindset with strong accountability, built to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle ambiguity with speed and precision.

Nice to Haves:

  • Financial Systems Integration: Experience connecting insurance data into ERP or financial systems (specifically Workday).
  • Extended Tech Stack: Exposure to Snowflake, Python, Power Query, or leveraging AI tools to streamline day-to-day workflows.
  • MGA Experience: Direct experience working within a true Managing General Agent (MGA) structure.
  • FP&A Capabilities: Familiarity with financial planning and analysis workflows alongside core actuarial duties.

Benefits

US & Canada Benefits:

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.


Compensation

Compensation:

  • ﻿The base salary range for this position is $80,000-120,000. This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.


﻿For Candidates Applying From the U.S and Canada:

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S or Canada without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

AI is used as a support tool, and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. By submitting your information, you acknowledge that the company may use AI tools as part of our evaluation. If you need a reasonable accommodation or alternative review process because of a disability or other legally protected basis, contact hiring@ledgebrook.com. Requesting an accommodation will not negatively affect your application.

SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.

title: Pharmacy Supply Chain Specialist
description:
Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.

Job Summary

The Pharmacy Supply Chain Spec obtains services at lowest cost consistent with approved quality and delivery standards. Prepares the appropriate acquisition instrument, consistent with Grady Health System Policies, for the procurement of goods and services. Ensures all actions initiated and exercised will be in accordance with sound Business practice. Recommends improvements in over-all purchasing program which will advance the objectives of the hospital.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Assures replenishment stock orders transmitted to drug wholesaler from dispensing sites. Assists with and at times facilities the preparation of Request for Proposal (RFPs).
  • Leads RFP process including facilitating technical review team and contract award recommendation as assigned.
  • Reviews orders to ensure selection of most cost effective drug option and appropriate quantities for purchase; determines alternative products when primary product is not available.
  • Arranges for shipment from other wholesaler divisions when necessary to assure product availability Inputs and processes return drug authorizations.
  • Prepares and submits orders to drug wholesaler in accordance with 340B split software vendor. Works on procurement issues as assigned.
  • Creates purchase orders, performs item maintenance and reconciles receiving documents in PeopleSoft.
  • Manages purchase orders to specialty pharmacy compounders (Stacy's, Pharmedia) and REM specialty pharmacies. Reconciles purchase orders with Accounts Payable (AP) to assure timely payment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Required: Associate Degree or above in business, finance, supply chain or healthcare related field.
  • Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in business, finance, supply chain or health care related field.
  • Required: Three (3) or more years experience in pharmacy, supply chain or health care.
  • Preferred: Hospital and/or Health System pharmacy procurement experience including 340B program .
  • Registered pharmacy technician with Georgia Board of Pharmacy; proficient with Microsoft Excel and Word.

Core Competencies
These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment.


1. Patient-Centered Care – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high-quality care that prioritizes the well-being and satisfaction of patients and their families.
2. Integrity & Accountability – Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and accepts responsibility for actions, decisions, and outcomes.
3. Collaboration & Teamwork – Builds positive relationships, works effectively across departments, and supports colleagues to achieve shared goals.
4. Communication – Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with patients, families, colleagues, and leadership.
5. Respect & Inclusion – Creates an inclusive environment by valuing diversity, treating others with dignity, and ensuring equitable care and opportunities for all.
6. Quality & Safety – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes.
7. Adaptability & Resilience – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure.
8. Continuous Improvement – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
9. Leadership & Professionalism – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.
10. Employee Experience Focus – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care.


Grady Total Rewards
At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our Total Rewards package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

  • Financial Security: Retirement savings plans with employer contributions, life insurance, and disability coverage.

title: Woonzorgadviseur frontoffice - 24 uur per week
description:
Woonzorgadviseur frontoffice

24 uur per week - Krimpenerwaard

Wil jij als verbindende schakel tussen zorg, wonen en welzijn écht het verschil maken voor ouderen? Ben jij communicatief sterk, weet je precies hoe je vraag en aanbod in de zorg samenbrengt en houd je altijd het belang van de bewoner voor ogen? Dan is deze vacature als Woonzorgadviseur frontoffice bij WelThuis echt iets voor jou.

Jouw baan als woonzorgadviseur frontoffice (Krimpenerwaard)
Als Woonzorgadviseur speel jij samen met twee directe collega's een cruciale rol in het begeleiden van nieuwe bewoners van aanmelding tot verhuizing naar één van onze locaties. Jij zorgt voor een beste passende match tussen de zorgvraag en ons aanbod.

Je taken in het kort:

  • Je coördineert en bewaakt het gehele instroomproces van bewoners

  • Je onderhoudt actief contact met familie, zorgmedewerkers, managers en behandelaren van de verschillende locaties

  • Je zorgt voor een optimale bedbezetting en een nauwkeurige administratieve afhandeling

  • Je voert kennismakingsgesprekken, rondleidingen en informeert bewoners over onze woonzorgarrangementen

  • Je regelt en beoordeelt (crisis)opnames, indicaties en meerzorgaanvragen

  • Je beheert de wachtlijsten en zorgt voor passende plaatsingen volgens wet- en regelgeving

  • Je neemt actief deel aan projectteams


Wie zijn jouw collega's?
Je maakt deel uit van een team van 12 woonzorgadviseurs. Samen zorgen jullie voor een goede afstemming tussen de zorgvraag en het zorgaanbod van WelThuis. Het team is verdeeld in drie subteams: drie frontoffice teams die actief zijn in de regio, en een backoffice team dat gevestigd is in Gouda. Je collega’s zijn betrokken en servicegerichte professionals die zich met enthousiasme inzetten voor onze zorgvragers en woonzorglocaties. Bij WelThuis staat werkplezier hoog in het vaandel. We hebben een informele, resultaatgerichte werksfeer waarin volop ruimte is voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Kom werken bij een organisatie die door eigen collega's voor de 2e keer op rij is verkozen tot ‘beste werkgever’!

Jij ontvangt

  • €3.212,50- €5.230,32 (o.b.v. 36 uur, CAO VVT FWG 55) afhankelijk van werkervaring

  • Een dienstverband van 24 uur per week

  • 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering

  • Een werkomgeving binnen een dynamische organisatie waar de visie ook echt wordt nageleefd!

  • Een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

Dit ben jij

  • Met jouw empathisch vermogen en doortastendheid krijg jij snel helder welke hulpvraag de bewoner heeft en welke zorg en diensten ingezet kunnen worden

  • Met jouw creativiteit denk jij in kansen en in oplossingen

  • Je werkt graag zelfstandig en je schakelt makkelijk met in- en externe partijen indien nodig

  • Het bezoeken van onze WelThuis-woonzorglocaties geeft extra waarde en plezier aan jouw werkdag

  • Naast de administratieve werkzaamheden haal je werkplezier uit het bezoeken van onze WelThuis-woonzorglocaties


Dit heb jij

  • Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding in de richting van Zorg en Welzijn (zoals HBO-V, SPH of Social Work)

  • Kennis van de gezondheidszorg, WLZ-indicaties en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en weet belangen goed af te wegen

  • Je bent in het bezit van rijbewijs B en een eigen auto

  • Je bent beschikbaar op woensdag, donderdag en vrijdag

Over WelThuis

WelThuis is een warme, innovatieve en ambitieuze zorgorganisatie met 17 woonzorglocaties in Zoetermeer, Gouda, Woerden, Bergambacht, Haastrecht, Schoonhoven, Stolwijk, Linschoten, Rotterdam en Zevenhuizen. Onze locaties zijn kleinschalige woonvoorzieningen voor mensen met een vorm van dementie en/of een lichamelijke zorgvraag.

Ons motto is: ‘Samen kan het wèl’. Dat geldt voor onze bewoners en ook voor de ruim 1100 betrokken (zorg)medewerkers. Met deze gezamenlijke visie werken we elke dag aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit van leven van onze bewoners én streven we naar goed werkgeverschap, waarin ruimte is voor groei, ontwikkeling en werkplezier.

Enthousiast?

Vul dan onderstaand formulier in! Wij reageren altijd binnen één werkdag. Zijn we enthousiast, dan nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking op dinsdag 13 oktober. Is er een klik? Dan plannen we een gesprek in om het contract in orde te maken. Een VOG is onderdeel van de procedure.

Heb je vragen?

title: Senior open to Mid Backend Software Engineer
description:
Ready for a challenge?


Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.


About this role


JET is growing its technical estate to make partner KYC (Know Your Customer) & KYB (Know Your Business) faster, smoother and scalable across the globe.

Our products are aimed both for our partners and our internal users, helping them navigate the complexities of each market easily.

In this role, you will be responsible for building high scale, distributed systems that can handle complexities across markets.

We're seeking a senior and a mid level software engineer with fresh ideas who drives bold, creative solutions to advance the JET’s global vision.


* Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home)


These are some of the key components to the position:


  • Work on large-scale, highly available, and resilient modern systems — supporting business continuity by maintaining our current systems and modernising partner systems within a small agile team. Design and build systems from scratch, collaborating with multiple engineering and product teams across the globe.
  • Own services end to end. Decide how best to build, test, deploy and monitor.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.
  • Drive knowledge sharing through demos, presentations, and tutorials.
  • Closely collaborate with other departments, including legal, compliance, and customer services.
  • Work in new and upcoming projects: Doing proof of concepts, solving real problems with product & business plus owning projects end to end.

Some of the technologies you will be working with: Kotlin, Python, PHP, Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, CI/CD with Gitlab,Github Actions, Kafka, AWS: SNS, SQS, ReactJS,Vue JS, MySql DB, NoSQL DBs like MongoDB, DynamoDB.


What will you bring to the team?


  • Hands-on experience working with object oriented languages: Kotlin or Java with sound understanding of 3rd party integrations, API Design, and development & CI/CD pipelines..
  • Experience with modern testing practices (unit, integration, regression).
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud Infrastructure like AWS / Google Cloud / Azure (knowledge only is ok for mid level)
  • Understanding of microservices and event driven architecture.
  • Experience with databases either Relational or NoSQL or both.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex matters and requirements to non-domain experts in a clear, simple and concise way.
  • Experience in vue.js is a non-mandatory plus,

At JET, this is how we play


Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.


At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.


What else are we delivering?


Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Platform Engineer

Job Description

So, who are we?

IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof.

We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

Your team

This role is part of our Platform Engineering team who are responsible for building the cloud and containers platform landscape to support the business applications via self-service capabilities and automation.

Your role in the Team's Success

The Senior Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical contributor responsible for building, evolving, and maintaining cloud platform infrastructure to ensure it is secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective.

The Senior Platform Engineer embeds best practices into platform design and delivery across Engineering, Security and FinOps. They operate as a hands-on expert, contributing to complex technical decisions, reducing platform risk, and enabling engineering teams to build and operate services with confidence, speed, and financial discipline. The role includes mentoring junior engineers and supporting knowledge sharing across the team.

What you'll do

  • Design and architect scalable AWS cloud infrastructure, developing IaC solutions using Terraform and leading cloud technology evaluation and standardisation initiatives
  • Build, optimise, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, establishing DevOps and DevSecOps best practices across the organisation
  • Architect and manage Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE) and implement platform engineering tools to deliver self-service capabilities via an IDP (e.g. Backstage)
  • Define and enforce monitoring, alerting, and observability standards to ensure infrastructure reliability and performance
  • Foster collaboration between development and operations teams, bridging gaps to drive a unified engineering culture
  • Mentor junior engineers, share knowledge across the team, and write and maintain documentation to support continuous learning and engineering best practices.

What you'll need for this role

Key Qualification Requirements:

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Experience: 7+ years in cloud infrastructure engineering with hands-on experience designing and administering complex platforms across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including deep knowledge of networking (VPC, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, BGP, OSPF) and IaaS/PaaS architectural patterns
  • Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation: 2+ years with IaC tools (Terraform or Ansible) and hands-on experience with orchestration and automation platforms (AWX, Ansible Tower, Terragrunt), scripting in Python, Bash, or Go
  • DevOps & DevSecOps: 2+ years designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, with strong knowledge of security best practices including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance
  • Kubernetes & Containers: 2+ years of Kubernetes administration across on-premises and cloud environments (EKS preferred, AKS, GKE), with proficiency in networking, RBAC, pod security, service mesh (Istio), and Docker image management
  • Platform Engineering & Developer Tooling: Experience implementing developer portals (Backstage), artifact repositories (JFrog Artifactory, Nexus), API gateways, and self-service platform engineering tools to support internal teams
  • Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Honeycomb, Prometheus, Grafana), including defining alerting standards and ensuring infrastructure reliability at scale
  • Architecture & Design: Strong grasp of microservices architecture, cloud networking protocols (Layer 2/3, MPLS), DNS, load balancing, and traffic management, with the ability to contribute to and implement technical direction
  • Version Control & Collaboration: Proficiency across version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) with the ability to operate autonomously and contribute to engineering standards across teams

How we work:

We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office -- which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other. When it comes to how we deliver, there are 5 things we want everyone to do to drive high performance, better learning and career satisfaction:

  • Lead and Inspire: Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
  • Think Big: Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
  • Champion the client: Understand and prioritise client's needs
  • Deliver at pace: Push for fast, sustainable growth;
  • Raise the bar: Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback

We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We're committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey. Learn more about our D&I approach here.

The Perks:

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.

Learn more about the Perks here!

Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!

title: Custo Art Intake Technician
description:
Job Title

Custo Art Intake Technician

Job Description

Art Intake Technician

Location-Holyoke, MA

Shift-8am-4:30pm


Who We Are

At Framebridge, we are disrupting the custom framing market by replacing a cumbersome experience with a delightful one. We are taking the market and expanding the market for custom framing, all while building a beloved brand associated with celebrating the best moments in life. In order to fulfill our mission, we have to build a great team across a number of disciplines – ecommerce, retail, design, and manufacturing. We are a consumer business operating online and in our growing fleet of retail stores.. We operate multiple manufacturing facilities that allow us to deliver a high-quality custom product at an affordable price with a quick turnaround. We exist, grow, and ultimately own the market by delighting customers who trust and value us.

We are a growing consumer based business operating online and in retail stores. We deliver high-quality custom products at an affordable price with a quick turnaround. We exist, grow, and ultimately own the market by delighting customers who trust and value us.


The Role

The Art Intake Associate is the first touchpoint in the manufacturing process, responsible for receiving, inspecting, and dispositioning customer artwork before it enters production. This role requires a high level of attention to detail and a commitment to art safety, as all artwork is treated as fragile and irreplaceable.


As a Framebridge Team Member, You Will

Show Pride: We stand behind our work, sweat the details, and strive for continuous improvement. We're proud to frame the things you love.


Grow Together: We embrace challenges with creative solutions and know that collaboration is the only way to succeed. We set big goals and keep raising the bar.


Adapt & Act: We are resilient, flexible, and proactive in an ever-changing world — open to evolving trends and new ideas.


Secure the Baton: We maintain strong follow-through and over-communicate to ensure a proper handoff. Personal responsibility and commitment to the mission are key.


Make it Special: We always look for more opportunities to make our product and experience special and delightful. We celebrate life's wins — our own and our customers'.


Build to Last: We build a product and a business that endure. We work every day to build lasting relationships — within our team and with our customers.

At Framebridge, our people are the heart of everything we build. We foster an inclusive, equitable, and collaborative environment where remarkable individuals take pride in their craft, elevate the customer experience, and are empowered to do the best work of their careers.



What You’ll Do


Art Reception & Inspection

  • Receive customer art arriving via retail shuttle and UPS packages
  • Open and unpack flat mail, tube mail, and other packaging formats - never discarding any package contents
  • Verify all physical items against the customer's work order
  • Photograph all artwork using the intake tool camera, ensuring the entire piece is visible
  • Visually inspect art and note condition upon arrival
  • Immediately notify a supervisor if art is missing or damaged, or does not match the order

Dispositioning & System Entry

  • Use the Art Intake tool to log and process each work order
  • Accurately complete the Dispositioning Form, including: art framing type, size group, wall location, ship-by date, and any matching set requirements
  • Verify the production category based on the work order and art inspection
  • Place artwork on the Disposition Wall for scheduling into production cells

Art Handling & Packaging

  • Maintain one-piece flow - process one work order at a time to prevent swaps
  • Package art into the appropriate sleeve or bin size; secure with clips
  • Follow proper storage procedures for canvas, tubes, 3D objects, and oversized pieces
  • Ensure the RFID Traveler accompanies each retail order throughout the process

title: Kersthulp The Mall
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een leuke bijbaan tijdens de drukste en gezelligste periode van het jaar, waarin je veel contact hebt met mensen én werkt in een gezellig team? Dan hebben wij de perfecte uitdaging voor jou!

Je verwelkomt klanten met energie, helpt ze bij het vinden van hun favoriete items en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen met een glimlach de winkel verlaat. Samen met je team creëer je een Boutique die straalt en uitnodigt. Van het aanvullen van de collectie tot het adviseren van klanten en het feestelijk inpakken van cadeautjes: jij zorgt voor een fijne en inspirerende winkelervaring.

Benieuwd hoe het is om in een van onze Boutiques te werken? Bekijk deze video!

  • Je bent in het weekend minimaal één dag beschikbaar;

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar tijdens de drukke periode rondom de feestdagen;

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. title: Director of Legal Affairs & Counsel
description:
-

A Great Place to Work

As a Certified Great Place to Work, we think that you are going to love it here. Your work will be meaningful to you. You will make a genuine difference in the lives of our aging guests and the families that love them. You will enjoy lasting bonds with the families you meet and with the teams you work on. And if you desire, you will experience real career growth where your expertise and dedication is valued and appreciated. We invite you to join our team!

Location: 20 E. Sunrise Highway, Valley Stream, New York, 11581

-

National Health Care Associates, provider of high-quality long-term care and short-term rehabilitation services, with over 40 skilled nursing facilities in the Northeast and New England, is seeking a Director of Legal Affairs & Counsel. This is a fantastic opportunity for the right candidate to join one of the premier healthcare organizations in the region.

What You'll Do:

The Director of Legal Affairs & Counsel serves as the organization's sole in-house legal and compliance professional, providing strategic legal guidance and risk management support across a multi-state healthcare and post-acute care network. Reporting directly to the CEO with a functional matrix to the CHRO, this role oversees compliance program administration, litigation management, healthcare regulatory matters, contract review, and general legal support for operating facilities and affiliated business entities.

This is a highly visible, hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong judgment, extreme responsiveness, and the ability to navigate a fast-paced healthcare environment with diverse legal and operational priorities. Because there is no internal legal department, the successful candidate must be equally comfortable executing routine daily legal tasks and setting enterprise-level legal strategy.

This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across a growing long-term care organization.

Position Responsibilities:

Compliance Program Management

  • Oversee the organization's compliance program, including hotline administration and multi-channel complaint intake, investigation, escalation, and resolution.
  • Ensure compliance concerns are appropriately documented, investigated, and remediated.
  • Monitor developments in healthcare compliance laws and regulations, including fraud and abuse requirements and related regulatory guidance.
  • Develop and deliver compliance education and training initiatives.
  • Support a culture of ethics, accountability, and regulatory compliance across all facilities.

Litigation & Risk Management

  • Manage a substantial portfolio of resident, family, and healthcare liability claims and litigation matters.
  • Direct and oversee outside counsel in all phases of litigation, from claim assessment through resolution.
  • Partner with third-party administrators, insurance carriers, and operational leadership to mitigate risk and manage exposure.
  • Evaluate litigation strategy, settlement recommendations, and case reserves.
  • Support enterprise-wide risk management initiatives.

Contracts & Transactions

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a wide range of agreements, including vendor, service, healthcare, hospital, and managed care contracts.
  • Partner with operational, purchasing, finance, and business leaders to assess contractual risk and business terms.
  • Provide legal support for acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions as needed.

Healthcare Regulatory Affairs

  • Advise leadership on healthcare regulatory matters affecting skilled nursing, long-term care, and post-acute care operations.
  • Interpret and apply federal and state healthcare regulations, including Medicare, Medicaid, Department of Health, and related agency requirements.
  • Assist facilities with regulatory inquiries, surveys, audits, investigations, and compliance initiatives.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with regulatory agencies and stakeholders.

General Legal Counsel

  • Provide legal guidance on commercial matters, collections, corporate initiatives, and ancillary business operations.
  • Support affiliated organizations and business entities on legal and regulatory matters.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on day-to-day legal and business issues.
  • Identify legal risks and develop practical, business-oriented solutions.

Day-to-Day Duties

  • Respond to compliance reports, resident and family complaints, and operational legal inquiries.
  • Coordinate investigations and track corrective actions.
  • Manage active litigation matters and communications with outside counsel.
  • Review and negotiate contracts submitted by operational and purchasing teams.
  • Advise facility leadership on healthcare regulatory and risk management issues.
  • Participate in executive discussions regarding strategic initiatives, transactions, and operational challenges.
  • Support affiliated businesses with legal and compliance matters as needed.
  • Provide responsive counsel to facility leaders, executives, and internal stakeholders across multiple states.

-

What We Offer

As part of National Health Care, our team enjoys:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
  • Comprehensive training and mentorship
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment
  • The chance to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents

Rate of Pay

USD $180,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.

-

What You'll Bring:

Required Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.
  • Active admission and good standing with at least one state bar.
  • 7+ years of legal experience, preferably with significant healthcare industry exposure.
  • Demonstrated experience managing litigation, outside counsel, and legal risk.
  • Experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare regulatory compliance, including Medicare, Medicaid, and long-term care regulations.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing a broad and evolving workload.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Operational Independence: Proven track record of operating successfully as a solo corporate counsel or as an autonomous individual contributor within a lean corporate department.
  • Outside Counsel Supervision: Demonstrated capability to independently audit, manage, and direct external law firms to maximize case outcomes while rigorously controlling outside legal spend.
  • Experience supporting skilled nursing, long-term care, post-acute care, hospital, or healthcare service organizations.
  • Department of Health, CMS, or healthcare regulatory agency experience.
  • Medical malpractice, healthcare liability defense, or healthcare regulatory law background.
  • Trial experience or meaningful exposure to litigation through trial proceedings.
  • Experience developing relationships with government agencies, regulators, and industry stakeholders.
  • Prior in-house counsel experience within a healthcare organization.
  • Experience managing high-volume litigation portfolios.

Key Success Factors

  • Customer-service mindset with a commitment to supporting facilities as internal clients.
  • Ability to balance strategic legal advice with hands-on execution.
  • Strong judgment in high-pressure and high-exposure situations.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial, and frequently changing environment.
  • Highly responsive, adaptable, and capable of managing competing priorities.
  • Willingness to engage with both routine operational matters and complex enterprise-level legal issues.

-

We Hire for Heart!

National Health Care Associates (National) is proud to be a family-run organization since 1984. Like family, each of National’s centers are unique but share common values: Kindness, Service, Compassion and Excellence. Today, our centers include more than 40 premier providers of short-term rehabilitation, skilled nursing, and post-hospital care including several named “Best Of” by US News & World Report. When you join the team at a National center, you join a team that provides life-changing care to thousands of patients, residents, and families in a Great Place to Work Certified environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status.

This is accomplished by performing a range of assurance activities to independently assess the quality and effectiveness of Morgan Stanley’s system of internal control, including risk management and governance systems and processes. IAD serves as an objective and independent function within the Firm’s risk management framework to foster continual improvement of risk management processes. This is a Director level position within Business Audit, which is responsible for inspecting controls in front, middle and back offices.


Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

Location: New York, NY (4x per week in office)

- Help identify risk and impact to relevant coverage area to prioritize areas of focus
- Execute and lead aspects of assurance activities (e.g., audits, continuous monitoring, closure verification) to assess risk and formulate a view on the control environment
- Facilitate conversations with stakeholders on risks, their impact and how well they are managed in a clear, timely and structured manner
- Assist in managing multiple deliverables in line with team priorities
- Solicit and provide feedback and participate in formal and on-the-job training to further develop self and peers


What you'll bring to the role:
- Understanding of business line and key regulations relevant to coverage area
- Strong understanding of audit principles, methodology, tools, and processes (e.g., risk assessments, planning, testing, reporting and continuous monitoring)
- Ability to identify and analyze multiple data sources to inform point of view
- Ability to ask meaningful questions, understand various viewpoints and adapt messaging accordingly
- A commitment to practicing inclusive behaviors
- At least 4 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role

- Relevant certifications (i.e., CIA, CPA, CFA, CIDA, SIE, Series licenses, etc.) preferred

title: Food Quality & Restaurant Experience Advisor
description:
Want to build a brighter, bolder future and cultivate your career? Join Ecolab’s team and help create a world in which we all thrive.


EcoSure, the brand protection division of Ecolab, partners with global brands to create an end-to-end brand protection strategy. Through a collaborative approach to on-site assessments, coaching, digital learning and industry best practices, we create a unique program that encompasses the critical components of any operation. EcoSure conducts more than 500,000 assessments annually in 140+ countries around the world. The results are real-time insights and actionable steps that mitigate brand risk and optimize guest experience.


Ecolab is seeking a Brand Protection Advisor to join our team in Columbus, OH. You’ll partner with clients to identify risks, reinforce brand standards, and drive continuous improvement, making a measurable impact on public health and customer satisfaction.

title: Chaplain Part-Time - Carson City, NV
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

This role is part-time in the Carson City/Reno area.

Hours are roughly 10hrs per week.


Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.


Ministry

• Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.

• Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.

• May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

• May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.

• May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.

• Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.

• May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.

• May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.

• Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.

• Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).

• Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

• With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.


Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).


Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.


Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

description:
CURRENT BRONSON EMPLOYEES - Please apply using the career worklet in Workday. This career site is for external applicants only.

Love Where You Work!

Team Bronson is compassionate, resilient and strong. We are driven by Positivity which inspires us to be our best and to go above and beyond for our patients, for one another, and for our community.

If you’re ready for a rewarding new career, join Team Bronson and be part of the experience.

Location

BHG Bronson Healthcare Group

Title

Leave of Absence Team Lead

The Leave of Absence (LOA) Team Lead serves as a non-supervisory process lead, providing advanced operational support, technical expertise, and workflow leadership for Bronson Healthcare Group’s Leave of Absence programs, including FMLA, ADA, Short-Term Disability (STD), Long-Term Disability (LTD), Paid Parental Leave (PPL), and Military Leave. This role manages a complex caseload while also functioning as the primary escalation point for long-term, high-risk, or multi-layered leave cases. The Team Lead supports LOA Analysts and the LOA Specialist by providing real-time consultation, quality review, training, and guidance to ensure accurate, compliant, and consistent leave administration. Working daily in Workday and Third-Party Administrator (TPA) systems, the role collaborates closely with Payroll, Employee Relations, HR Business Partners, HRIS, and external vendors to maintain seamless LOA operations.

This position plays a critical role in process standardization, system testing, vendor coordination, reporting, and leadership communication, proactively identifying risks, trends, and improvement opportunities while keeping LOA leadership informed and supported.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a volume of the alphabetical caseload across FMLA, ADA, STD, LTD, PPL, and Military Leave programs.

  • Perform the same core work as an HR Analyst while assuming additional responsibility for escalations, workflow oversight, and quality assurance.

  • Track and manage complex timelines involving overlapping leave types, multiple extensions, intermittent usage, and long-term leave scenarios.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for LOA Analysts, the LOA Specialist, employees, leaders, and internal HR partners.

  • Support complex ADA cases in collaboration with the LOA Specialist, including documentation review and interactive process guidance.

  • Lead operational review of long-term disability claims, Military Leave cases, and seven-month leave reviews.

  • Prepare and review hardship analyses and provide recommendations to Employee Relations during recurring case review meetings.

  • Evaluate return-to-work readiness for extended leave and ensure compliance with policy and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead weekly LOA team huddles, providing coaching, clarification on workflows, regulatory updates, and operational guidance.

  • Conduct quality reviews of case documentation, Workday transactions, and payroll coding to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance.

  • Identify gaps, risks, or inefficiencies in LOA workflows and communicate actionable improvement recommendations to the Director.

  • Ensure LOA, ADA, and related policies, SOPs, and job aids are accurate, current, and easy to interpret and support and co-lead LOA process improvement initiatives and workflow standardization efforts.

  • Act as the primary operational liaison with Third-Party Administrators, participating in regular meetings to review case activity, trends, escalations, and workflow alignment.

  • Coordinate resolution of vendor-related issues and support process enhancements to improve service delivery and compliance.

  • Provide ongoing, non-supervisory coaching and on-the-job support to LOA team members.

  • Facilitate leaders, employee education, and training.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining LOA-related training materials, SOPs, and communication resources.

  • Perform and review Workday LOA transactions, including EIB creation and loading as needed.

  • Oversee LOA-related reporting, including STD reviews, seven-month case tracking, and team-level analytics.

  • Participate in annual Workday testing for LOA and ADA updates, identifying system or workflow issues, and partnering with HRIS for resolution.

  • Support payroll accuracy by reviewing exempt payroll, approvals, reconciliations, and sign-off processes.

Essential Qualifications

Minimum Education:
Bachelor’s degree required; Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, or related field preferred.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of progressive HR experience, with significant emphasis on LOA, ADA, STD/LTD, disability management, or regulatory compliance.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex and long-term leave cases and serving as an escalation resource.

  • Strong experience using Workday and Third-Party Administrator platforms (Sedgwick preferred).

  • Proven ability to act as a process lead, provide peer guidance, conduct quality reviews, and influence operational outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Expert knowledge of FMLA, ADA, STD, LTD, PPL, and Military Leave regulations and administration

  • Advanced understanding of long-term and complex leave case management and ADA interactive processes

  • Strong proficiency with HRIS and leave platforms (Workday and TPA systems; Sedgwick preferred)

  • Ability to interpret regulations and apply them consistently across complex scenarios

  • Strong analytical, investigative, and documentation skills with exceptional attention to detail

  • Ability to lead workflows and influence outcomes without direct supervisory authority

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including facilitation and training capabilities

  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive medical and personal information

  • Collaborative approach to partnering with Payroll, Employee Relations, HRIS, vendors, and leadership

Physical and Sensory Demands

  • Prolonged sitting and computer use (up to 80% of workday).

  • Frequent visual concentration for detailed payroll data review and system analysis.

  • Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting of light objects (up to 20 pounds).

  • High level of mental concentration required to meet strict benefit deadlines and regulatory compliance standards.

Work Environment

  • Work is performed in a professional office or hybrid home office environment.

  • The position requires extensive computer use and frequent interaction with Finance, HR, IT, leadership, external vendors, and regulatory agencies.

  • The environment is climate-controlled with minimal exposure to physical hazards.

description:

BUILDING A WORLD CLASS TEAM STARTS WITH YOU

At the heart of CSA Group is a vision: making the world a better, safer, more sustainable place. It's been part of our mission for nearly one hundred years: from the first engineering standard for railway bridges developed in 1919, to more than 3,500 standards, codes & related products today.

Headquartered in Canada, with a global footprint of more than 30 labs and offices across Europe, Asia and North America, CSA Group tests, inspects and certifies a wide range of products - from every day househould items to leading edge technology-to meet exacting requirements for safety, performance and environmental impact.

Our employees take pride in making a difference in people's lives through the work that we do. We're looking for people like you to help make it happen.

Job Summary:

This role will act as the senior on-site technical resource for CSA’s Toronto location and is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of site support services: end-user computing, endpoint build and lifecycle, the corporate mobile fleet, meeting room technology, print services, IT asset control and on-site infrastructure hands.


Responsibilities:

  • Acts as the technical resource and final on-site escalation point for the Toronto location, resolving complex end-user issues across hardware, operating systems, applications, and peripherals before engaging Tier 3, network, security, or vendor support.
  • Manages the on-site support queue in SolarWinds Service Desk, logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and resolving tickets against defined service level targets.
  • Builds, maintains, and publishes the standard laptop and desktop images, and images, configures, and deploys new devices so every device is delivered ready for the employee's first day.
  • Ensures deployed endpoints remain current on operating system versions, firmware, and security patches, and verifies required security configuration, including disk encryption, endpoint protection, and multi-factor authentication enrolment, prior to release.
  • Recovers, wipes, re-images, refurbishes, and repurposes returned laptops, and prepares end-of-life equipment for secure data destruction and disposal.
  • Procures, configures, deploys, and supports the corporate mobile fleet (Apple iOS), enrolling and managing devices in Microsoft Intune and performing remote lock or wipe as needed.
  • Installs, configures, and troubleshoots the Xerox multifunction device fleet, including print queues, secure print release, and consumables management.
  • Installs, cables, and commissions meeting room technology, including displays, cameras, and microphones, and configures and supports Microsoft Teams Rooms systems.
  • Provides hands-on technical setup and live support for on-site meetings, standards committee sessions, town halls, and events, including travel to off-site meetings as required.
  • Troubleshoots wireless connectivity and client-side network issues, escalating to the network team with structured diagnostic evidence, and acts as remote hands for directed work in the site network closet.
  • Owns and maintains the IT asset register across the full hardware lifecycle, and manages the IT stock room, including spares, consumables, reorder points, and periodic inventory reconciliation.
  • Delivers IT onboarding for new hires, including equipment handover and account provisioning, and executes offboarding activities, including equipment recovery and access removal.
  • Documents resolutions, builds and maintains knowledge base articles and site runbooks, and drives down repeat ticket volume through self-service and permanent fixes.
  • Escorts and oversees third-party vendors and contractors performing technology work on site, holding service providers to agreed response and quality expectations.
  • Provides guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to less experienced technicians, managed service providers, and colleagues supporting other CSA locations.
  • Demonstrates superior customer service, supporting users at all technical skill levels in person and over the phone, and closes tickets to user satisfaction.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Information Technology related Bachelor Degree or College Diploma or equivalent, or degree with 5 plus years of information systems experience.
  • Broad practical knowledge of end-user computing hardware, Windows and macOS operating systems, endpoint management tooling, and common business applications.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, wireless connectivity) sufficient to isolate and resolve client-side issues and escalate with evidence.
  • Practical audio-visual skills, including low-voltage cabling, display and camera mounting, and room commissioning.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a structured, methodical approach to isolating root causes and a preference for permanent fixes over workarounds.
  • High degree of self-motivation, personal discipline, and accountability, with the ability to work productively without direct supervision.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing demands and scheduled project work concurrently.
  • Valid driver's license is required, with travel within Canada to support standards committee meetings and other CSA locations.
  • Certifications considered an asset: CompTIA A+ or Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, ITIL Foundation, or AVIXA CTS. Bilingualism (English/French) is considered an asset.

This position requires regular in-person attendance and punctuality in accordance with Company policies. Additionally, the ability to interact well with other employees and work overtime, as necessary, is required.

title: Faculty in Biomedical Sciences - Physiology
description:
Job Description:

Reporting to the Chair, Department of Biomedical Sciences, this role will function as member of a collaborative teaching team and will develop and deliver a medical curriculum in the anatomical sciences. The anatomical sciences program in the first two years is non-cadaveric and integrated with significant component of clinical imaging, including ultrasound. The third year is composed of materials provided to learners at the bedside. The fourth year provides opportunities for cadaveric dissection experience in electives.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

Teaching 50-70%

  • Participate as a member of a collaborative team to teach anatomical sciences across the four years of medical school.
  • Serve as subject matter expert in Anatomy (gross anatomy, developmental anatomy [embryology], microscopic anatomy [histology], and neuroanatomy/neuroscience).
  • Develop and maintain educational materials in the anatomical sciences for medical students.
  • Develop educational materials which support Osteopathic Principles and Practice.

Administration 5-10%

  • Collaborate with adjunct clinical faculty in the delivery of biomedical education.
  • Serve as subject matter lead in areas of expertise.
  • Participate in interviewing and hiring of faculty.

Service 5-10%

  • Participate in student interviewing, mentorship, and career counseling.
  • Serve on selected committees at the discretion of the Dean.
  • Participate in and/or develop and deliver professional development for KHSC.
  • Assist the Associate Dean for Pre-Clinical Education and Department Chair in accreditation functions to include document creation, data collection and management, education of faculty on accreditation, and other accreditation-related functions as assigned.
  • Serve with relevant professional organizations as members of committees or boards.
  • Foster a positive culture amongst the students, faculty, and KHSC-KansasCOM staff.

Research and Scholarly Activity 20-30%

  • Engage in scholarly activity that results in presentations at professional meetings and/or peer-reviewed journals.
  • Promote and mentor student research.
  • Serve as a peer-reviewer and/or editorial board member for conferences and/or journals.
  • Participate in seeking external funding for research activities.

Perform other related duties, as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None

QUALIFICATION(S):

An academic with a track record of proven effective academic experience in biomedical sciences education (medical school experience preferred).

  • A completed master’s degree or progress toward a terminal degree for an Instructor position.
  • A terminal degree (Ph.D., DSc, DO, MD, etc.) from an accredited institution of higher education with appropriate experience for an Assistant Professor (or higher) position
  • Maintain appropriate licensure for practice in health care, if applicable.
  • Good standing with all regulatory and governmental boards and agencies.
  • Experience using innovative teaching methods and proficiency in exam item (COMLEX and/or USMLE) writing.
  • A record of success as an educator.
  • Experience in peer-reviewed publications/national presentations.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Ability to work collaboratively in an educational team.
  • Leadership abilities in influencing and shaping performance.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and enthusiasm to contribute to organizational growth and development.
  • Strong knowledge base in medical education assessment.
  • Familiarity with AOA COCA requirements and accreditation reporting.
  • Strong, effective, and diplomatic oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent public speaking skills.
  • Excellent service skills relevant to supervisor, peers, direct reports, medical students, other faculty, and staff.

Kansas Health Science University offers a generous compensation and benefits package, as well as the opportunity to work for a leader in the field of education. Some of our key benefits include: generous paid time-off, medical and dental coverage, company-paid life and disability insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, multiple flexible spending accounts (FSA), tuition reimbursement, professional development, and regular employee appreciation events.
