title: ServiceNow System Admin and Developer
description:
Join OneAdvanced

ServiceNow SysAdmin and Developer

OneAdvanced uses ServiceNow across a number of key processes including Lead to Order, Project to Value, Order to Cash and Request to Resolve. The OneAdvanced IT Service Management team support the platform in service. The core elements are; platform, integration hub, Portal, CSM, ITSM and ITOM.

We are currently seeking an enthusiastic and motivated individual to join our team, actively participating in the deployment of the platform into business as usual and thereafter in support.

As a member of the ServiceNow Centre of Excellence and a SystemAdministrator and Developer, you will play a crucial role in taking the platform forward and continuing to deliver value to the business from the implementation. You will be responsible for daily administrative tasks but also the ongoing development, design, and support of technical solutions on the ServiceNow platform, along with stakeholders and team members. This role will be located in our Birmingham office. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

You will work closely with the IT Service Desk, and cross functional business teams.

Responsibilities

  • Performing intermediate to advanced level development tasks within the ITSM/CSM/ITOM applications within the ServiceNow platform
  • ServiceNow Platform administration, management, and support including deployments.
  • Creating and/or maintaining Service Catalog items, some of which require complex catalogue development experience and knowledge.
  • Creating and or maintaining components such as Server-side scripts, ACLs, Business Rules, UI Actions, UI Policies, and AJAX using languages such as Javascript, Angular, and Python
  • Developing client-focused solutions in the following modules – Customer Services, Customer and Service Operations workspaces, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management, Knowledge Management, Asset Management, CMDB, Virtual Agent, and CSM/Employee Portal
  • Create and maintain system design and operations documentation.
  • Monitor and report on development progress, status, and metrics to stakeholders.
  • Commit to continuous improvement and learning of ServiceNow best practices, tools, and technology.

Skills and Experience

  • Self-starter used to small teams and customer facing
  • A ServiceNow Administrator certification and Implementation Specialist (ITSM or CSM).
  • Experience of development on a large transformation project in an agile environment where ServiceNow was integrated with multiple enterprise tier applications; like Salesforce/CRM, NetSuite, ERPs
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience with ServiceNow development
  • Strong understanding of development methodologies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams, while fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to be hands on and work in the detail as and when required.
  • Ability to self-manage and work independently, work to tight deadlines, prioritize workloads and work with related internal business functions.

Preferred

  • Experience with Performance Analytics
  • Reporting and Dashboards.

What You Will Do

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day administration, development and support of the ServiceNow platform, ensuring the platform remains stable, secure and fit for business needs.
  • Design, develop and implement ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM and ITOM, including enhancements, workflows, integrations and platform improvements.
  • Configure and develop ServiceNow applications, including Service Catalog, Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, Asset Management, CMDB, Virtual Agent and Employee/CSM Portals.
  • Build and maintain technical components including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, server-side scripting, AJAX and other ServiceNow development components.
  • Support the deployment of ServiceNow into business-as-usual operations, providing ongoing technical support, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with the IT Service Desk, business stakeholders, architects, developers and other technology teams to understand requirements and deliver practical, customer-focused solutions.
  • Contribute to ServiceNow integrations with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, CRM, NetSuite and other ERP and business systems.
  • Investigate and resolve platform issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable technical solutions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, system designs, support documentation and operational procedures.
  • Monitor delivery progress, platform performance, development metrics and key activities, providing clear updates to stakeholders.
  • Follow ServiceNow development standards, governance and best practices, while identifying opportunities to improve the platform and ways of working.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and trusted technical partner, providing guidance to colleagues and stakeholders and supporting the wider ServiceNow Centre of Excellence.
  • Be comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced environment, balancing development, administration, support and project delivery priorities.

What You Will Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a ServiceNow Administrator and Developer, with a minimum of 5 years' ServiceNow development experience.
  • Proven experience delivering ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM and/or ITOM environments.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow platform administration, configuration, development, deployments and support.
  • Practical experience developing ServiceNow components using JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting technologies, with knowledge of Angular and Python advantageous.
  • Experience building and maintaining complex Service Catalog solutions and workflows.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, Asset Management, CMDB, Service Portal and CSM.
  • Experience working on large transformation programmes in an Agile environment, particularly where ServiceNow is integrated with multiple enterprise applications such as Salesforce, NetSuite and ERP platforms.
  • ServiceNow Administrator certification, ideally supported by an Implementation Specialist certification in ITSM or CSM.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A self-starter who is comfortable working independently within a small, customer-focused team and taking ownership through to completion.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work to tight deadlines and collaborate effectively across business and technology teams.
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to get into the detail when required, rather than relying solely on others for technical delivery.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in keeping up to date with ServiceNow best practices, new capabilities and emerging technologies.
  • Experience with Performance Analytics, reporting and dashboards would be desirable.

What We Do For You

Wellbeing that means something

  • 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays (and the option to buy more) plus 1 paid volunteering day every year
  • Exceptional family leave, 26 weeks fully paid maternity/adoption, 4 weeks fully paid paternity, 22 weeks fully paid shared parental leave, plus 5 days paid bereavement leave
  • Robust sick pay of up to 13 weeks full pay + 13 weeks half pay
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support

Financial benefits that have your back

  • Income protection: up to 75% salary for 5 years if you ever need it

Grow your career with us

Making a Difference

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Bally’s Intralot is a newly formed company established through the combination of Intralot and Bally’s International Interactive, positioning the group as a top iGaming operator and a leading global provider of lottery solutions.

Bally’s Intralot is uniquely positioned across digital online gaming markets, lottery, iLottery, and sports betting. Operating at the intersection of technology, regulation, and entertainment. We are optimally positioned to capitalise on strong global growth trends driven by digital adoption and regulatory expansion across lottery and iGaming markets.

Well, what about the team?

You'll lead a new AI Engineering function that runs in two halves under one team: R&D proves what's possible in personalisation, recommendation, search and agents; a delivery layer ships it into the live product for real players.

This is a founding leadership role. You'll build density around an established AI R&D nucleus, drive its technical execution, grow the engineers in it, and stay close enough to the work to lead from the front across the lobby and discovery experience and the content pipelines behind it: recommendation, contextual bandits, dynamic categorisation, advanced search, agents, and automatic content generation.

It's a hands-on leadership role: you own the technical bar and the how, line-manage and grow the team, and carry enough technical weight to make the hard calls and be trusted on them.

So, what will you be doing?

  • Drive the technical execution of the AI R&D agenda: decide how problems get approached, which technical and architectural bets are worth making, and how capability gets proven across personalisation, recommendation, search and agents.

  • Lead one team spanning R&D and delivery: line-manage, grow, and unblock the engineers, and be accountable for both proving capability and shipping it into the live product.

  • Set the production bar and standards for AI features end to end — how experimental work crosses into hardened, observable, maintainable systems without losing its edge.

  • Stay hands-on where it counts: lead from the front on the hard problems, pressure test the technical bets, and be credible in the code without owning delivery of every feature yourself.

  • Own the path from validated prototype to live: real-time personalisation, recommendation, search and ranking against live traffic, within real latency budgets and reliability realities.

  • Hold a high engineering bar on AWS and TypeScript — clean CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, testing, and LLMOps for running model-backed systems in production.

  • Shape delivery against the roadmap with the VP, product managers, data analysts and Staff Engineers, and make the capability compound across brands rather than be rebuilt per brand.

  • Work within Responsible Gambling and UKGC requirements, in a regulated, real money, real-time domain.

And what will you need?

  • Significant commercial software engineering experience, including experience leading technical teams or engineering functions.

  • Strong expertise in TypeScript and Python, with a proven track record of delivering AI, machine learning or data-driven solutions into production, including recommendation engines, intelligent search, ranking systems or LLM-powered applications.

  • Extensive experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS, with strong knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability and modern engineering practices.

  • Experience delivering high-performance, real-time systems that operate reliably at scale with demanding latency requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience leading the successful transition of AI solutions from research or proof of concept into robust, production-ready services.

  • Experience establishing technical standards, driving engineering excellence and mentoring or developing engineers within high-performing teams.

Skills & Behaviours:

  • A technical leader who enjoys building, mentoring and developing engineering teams while creating an environment where innovation can thrive.

  • Able to balance experimentation with engineering discipline, making sound technical decisions that deliver long-term value.

  • Confident leading technical discussions, influencing architecture and making complex decisions across multiple stakeholders.

  • Passionate about building scalable, maintainable and observable AI systems using modern engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, data and leadership teams.

  • Comfortable remaining hands-on with technology while providing strategic technical leadership and direction.

What benefits will you get?

  • 25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance.

  • Health insurance.

  • Volunteering days.

  • Home office allowance.

  • Wellness or Gym allowance.

  • Flexi-block policy allowing you to work abroad for up to four weeks a year.

DNA / Values:

At Bally’s Intralot we are driven by a set of core values that we like to call our DNA. We strive to embody our DNA and keep them at the heart of everything we do!

We Win as One, we succeed together - across every location and every function. We collaborate openly, raise each other up, and share the wins. We're Powered by Curiosity, we ask questions, challenge assumptions and make space to learn and innovate. We have Fun with Purpose, we bring creativity, energy and joy to how we work and what we deliver, because when people enjoy what they do, the work is better for everyone. Our teams Embrace the Possibility, when opportunity appears, we act. When the unexpected hits, we adapt. We don’t wait for change - we move towards it. At Bally's Intralot, we Guard the Game, we protect what matters most, fair play for our players, integrity for our partners, and accountability in everything we do.

Equal Opportunities

At Bally’s Intralot, we are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and working conditions. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are important to us, and we encourage a culture where everyone can be themselves at work. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success, this is our superpower.

title: Associate Principal, Healthcare Consulting
description:
Company Description

Press Ganey is the leading experience measurement, data analytics, and insights provider for complex industries—a status we earned over decades of deep partnership with clients to help them understand and meet the needs of their key stakeholders. Our earliest roots are in U.S. healthcare –perhaps the most complex of all industries. Today we serve clients around the globe in every industry to help them improve the Human Experiences at the heart of their business. We serve our clients through an unparalleled offering that combines technology, data, and expertise to enable them to pinpoint and prioritize opportunities, accelerate improvement efforts and build lifetime loyalty among their customers and employees.

Like all great companies, our success is a function of our people and our culture. Our employees have world-class talent, a collaborative work ethic, and a passion for the work that have earned us trusted advisor status among the world’s most recognized brands. As a member of the team, you will help us create value for our clients, you will make us better through your contribution to the work and your voice in the process. Ours is a path of learning and continuous improvement; team efforts chart the course for corporate success.

Our Mission:

We empower organizations to deliver the best experiences. With industry expertise and technology, we turn data into insights that drive innovation and action.

Our Values:

To put Human Experience at the heart of organizations so every person can be seen and understood.

  • Energize the customer relationship: Our clients are our partners. We make their goals our own, working side by side to turn challenges into solutions.

  • Success starts with me: Personal ownership fuels collective success. We each play our part and empower our teammates to do the same.

  • Commit to learning: Every win is a springboard. Every hurdle is a lesson. We use each experience as an opportunity to grow.

  • Dare to innovate: We challenge the status quo with creativity and innovation as our true north.

  • Better together: We check our egos at the door. We work together, so we win together.

Press Ganey is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or disabled veterans in the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation to apply for a position online or for your interviews or assessments, please contact us at acommodations@pressganey.com Please provide your contact information and the details of your request so we can best assist you.

Location: Remote, U.S.-Based

Travel: Up to 75%

Position Overview

Press Ganey / Qualtrics is seeking a highly motivated and analytically driven Associate Principal, Healthcare Consulting to partner with health system & health plan clients on strategic initiatives that improve patient experience, member experience, quality outcomes, workforce engagement, and organizational performance.

As a trusted advisor and engagement leader, you will work directly with healthcare executives and operational leaders to transform complex data into actionable strategies that drive measurable results. This role combines deep healthcare expertise, advanced analytics, executive facilitation, and consultative problem-solving to help clients achieve sustainable performance improvement.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of inpatient healthcare operations, patient experience, member experience, and quality improvement methodologies, and the ability to influence change at all levels of an organization.

What You'll Do

Client Consulting & Engagement Leadership

  • Lead analytics and insight development for consulting engagements focused on patient experience, member experience, quality improvement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation.

  • Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-level recommendations and strategic action plans.

  • Facilitate workshops, executive briefings, strategic planning sessions, and performance review meetings with senior healthcare leaders.

  • Partner with clients to design, implement, and sustain experience transformation initiatives.

  • Establish success metrics and measurement frameworks that demonstrate engagement impact and return on investment.

  • Manage multiple client workstreams simultaneously while ensuring exceptional quality and timely delivery.

Analytics & Strategic Insights

  • Analyze Press Ganey and client datasets to identify performance trends, root causes, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop compelling dashboards, scorecards, presentations, and data visualizations that support decision-making at the executive level.

  • Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to guide strategy development and operational improvement efforts.

  • Collaborate with internal subject matter experts, analytics teams, and engagement leaders to validate findings and develop recommendations.

  • Identify leading indicators and performance drivers related to patient experience, quality outcomes, employee engagement, and operational effectiveness.

Executive Partnership & Business Growth

title: Sr. Director Commercial Loan Operations
description:
Position Title

Sr. Director Commercial Loan Operations

Location

Hicksville, NY 11801

Job Summary

The Senior Director - Commercial Loan Operations is responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction and execution of the Commercial Loan Operations services that support Flagstar’s $60B commercial, private banking and letter of credit portfolios. The services provided span the lifecycle, including Loan Closing and Booking, Loan Servicing, Collateral and Document Management, Reporting, and Quality Control. The role oversees a diverse portfolio of commercial lending products including C&I, CRE, Syndications and Participations, Builder/Construction Administration, Private Banking, and other specialized lending solutions. Responsible for ensuring operational excellence across the commercial loan lifecycle, the Senior Director will drive continuous improvement of the risk and control environment, strengthen governance frameworks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
This leader partners closely with Commercial Banking, Credit, Risk, Technology, and other key stakeholders to support business objectives while balancing service, risk, and operational efficiency. This leader will drive large-scale operational transformation initiatives, technology modernization, process automation, system conversions, and organizational effectiveness across a complex, high-volume commercial lending portfolio.
Success in the role requires a strong understanding of commercial loan structures, product complexity, operational risk management, and the ability to scale processes and controls to support portfolio growth. The Senior Director is responsible for developing and executing business plans, enhancing operational capabilities, establishing workforce strategies, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products and services that support the Bank's long-term growth objectives. Equally important is building a trusted and effective working relationship with business partners to drive best-in-class service.

Job Responsibilities:

Executive Leadership & Strategic Direction


  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide vision, strategy, and operating model for Commercial Loan Operations in alignment with the Bank's growth objectives, risk appetite, and profitability goals.
  • Serve as a key executive leader within Commercial Loan Operations, influencing enterprise strategy and contributing to bank-wide initiatives and governance committees.
  • Partner with Executive Leadership to align operational capabilities with strategic priorities, including portfolio growth, product expansion, and client experience optimization.
  • Lead organizational readiness efforts supporting mergers, acquisitions, portfolio transfers, and large-scale system conversions and transformation initiatives.
  • Establish short- and long-term strategic priorities to optimize operational performance, scalability, and service delivery.
  • Evaluate industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments to continuously enhance operational effectiveness and competitive positioning. This can include benchmarking performance against peers to identify opportunities to differentiate customer experience.

Commercial Loan Operations Oversight and Management


  • Provide executive oversight for all Commercial Loan Operations functions, including Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Lending, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Syndicated Lending, Construction and Builder Finance, Healthcare and Specialty Lending, Loan Boarding and Funding, Loan Servicing, Collateral and Documentation Management, Reporting and Metrics, and Quality Control.
  • Ensure operational readiness and support for complex lending structures and specialized commercial products across the enterprise.
  • Establish, monitor, and enforce enterprise service level standards (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational performance objectives.
  • Drive continuous process improvement, workflow optimization, and capacity planning across all operational teams.
  • Lead operational support for high-growth lending initiatives while maintaining appropriate controls, risk disciplines, and quality standards.
  • Ensure high standards of technical and operational quality across all functions and product lines.
  • Continuously evaluate/oversee suppliers, vendors and managed service partners to monitor performance, services provided as well as compliance with service levels and contractual agreements.

Risk Management, Compliance & Governance

  • Serve as the senior operational executive accountable for regulatory compliance, operational risk management, audit readiness, and control effectiveness across Commercial Loan Operations.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Enterprise Risk Management to ensure adherence to all applicable federal and state regulations, including OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, and CFPB requirements, and applicable safety and soundness standards.
  • Provide executive leadership during regulatory examinations, internal audits, compliance reviews, and issue remediation programs.
  • Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks, key risk indicators (KRIs), operational risk assessments, and control monitoring programs.
  • Proactively identify, document, and communicate operational risk exposures and internal control weaknesses; implement corrective action plans as required.
  • Ensure full compliance with the Bank's Information Security, Cybersecurity, Data Governance, and Third-Party Risk Management policies and programs.

Operational Excellence & Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives focused on automation, digitization, workflow reengineering, and operational scalability.
  • Champion continuous improvement methodologies to drive efficiencies, reduce operational risk, and improve client outcomes.
  • Sponsor and oversee implementation of new technologies, commercial loan servicing platforms, workflow automation tools, and digital solutions, including leveraging and deploying AI technology.
  • Direct commercial loan system migrations, core banking conversions, and large-scale technology implementations from planning through execution.
  • Develop operational frameworks and infrastructure to support future growth, evolving product strategies, and changing client expectations.
  • Leverage performance metrics, analytics, and industry benchmarking data to drive data-informed decision-making and operational improvements.

Financial & Performance Management

  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, workforce planning strategies, and vendor expenditures in alignment with financial objectives.
  • Establish comprehensive KPI, KRI, productivity, quality, and financial reporting frameworks for executive and board-level audiences.
  • Monitor operational expenses and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency while maintaining service quality and risk standards.
  • Provide executive reporting and presentations to Senior Leadership, Executive Committees, Operational Risk Committees, and Board-level forums as required.
  • Ensure consistent achievement of operational performance targets, business objectives, and strategic milestones.
  • Uses independent judgment and discretion to make enterprise-level decisions regarding operational strategy, resource allocation, and risk management.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead a large, geographically dispersed management organization consisting of Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, Team Leads, and Operations professionals.
  • Build a high-performing, diverse, and inclusive culture focused on accountability, engagement, innovation, and exceptional client service.
  • Develop and maintain succession plans and leadership pipelines to support future organizational growth and business continuity.
  • Champion employee development through coaching, mentoring, talent reviews, performance management, and leadership development programs.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, operational excellence, and risk awareness across all levels of the organization.
  • May be responsible for talent management functions including employment, performance evaluations, staff development/training, disciplinary actions, succession planning, and ensuring all staff comply with compliance requirements.

Relationship Management & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the senior operational liaison between Commercial Banking, Credit Administration, Treasury Management, Finance, Technology, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Risk Management functions.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with internal and external stakeholders to advance operational and strategic objectives.
  • Lead strategic vendor management programs, oversee critical third-party partnerships, and ensure appropriate service levels and contractual compliance.
  • Actively engage with regulators, examiners, and industry organizations as appropriate.
  • Represent the Bank through active participation in industry forums, banking associations, regulatory interactions, and community engagement activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross-functional insights. Aligns relationship-building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Establish a structured and efficient method to collect and analyze business partner satisfaction data to identify opportunities for improvement.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and completes required compliance training. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
  • Sponsors and leads enterprise initiatives supporting Commercial Banking Operations strategy and transformation.
  • Participates in enterprise governance committees, operational risk committees, and strategic planning forums.
  • Performs other executive-level responsibilities as assigned by senior leadership.
  • Represent Flagstar at key industry events and forums

JOB REQUIREMENTS


Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: High School / High School Equivalency (GED, HiSET, TASC) / Foreign Equivalent.
  • Minimum experience required: 15+ Years of progressive banking experience with significant leadership responsibility in Commercial Loan Operations.
  • 10+ years of leadership experience managing large, multi-functional commercial loan/lending operations teams or equally relevant functional area.
  • Demonstrated experience leading commercial loan or commercial lending operations within a large regional, super-regional, national bank, or similarly complex financial institution.
  • Extensive experience supporting Commercial & Industrial (C&I), Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Syndicated Lending, Construction Finance, and specialty lending products.
  • Demonstrated expertise supporting complex commercial lending portfolios and products, including the operational implications of varying loan structures, documentation requirements, servicing complexities, and risk considerations.
  • Proven leadership of operational transformation initiatives, including process optimization, workflow enhancement, operating model improvements, technology implementations, and system conversions.
  • Significant experience managing regulatory examinations, internal audits, compliance programs, and enterprise operational risk management initiatives.
  • Experience leading through mergers, acquisitions, portfolio integrations, and large-scale organizational change programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent process improvement credentials.
  • Experience managing commercial loan operations supporting portfolios exceeding $20 billion in assets.
  • Experience with commercial lending platforms, loan origination systems (LOS), loan servicing systems, and workflow automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with digital transformation initiatives within a large-scale commercial banking environment.

Job Competencies:

  • Executive leadership and enterprise strategic planning with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into measurable operational outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in commercial lending operations, loan servicing, collateral management, and quality control across complex product portfolios.
  • Enterprise risk management, regulatory governance, and operational control framework development.
  • Large-scale organizational leadership, talent development, and succession planning across geographically dispersed teams.
  • Financial acumen includes budget management, workforce planning, and operational performance management.
  • Operational excellence and large-scale process transformation using Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Vendor and third-party risk management, including contract negotiation and strategic partnership oversight.
  • Executive communication and board-level presentation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and process mapping skills applied at an enterprise level.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, high-volume operations within highly regulated banking environments.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross-functional insights. Aligns relationship-building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying the importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
  • Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

  • Assist patients with activities of daily living (ADLs)—including hygiene, grooming, meals, and hydration—to promote comfort, dignity, and participation in treatment
  • Measure and document clinical observations (vital signs, weight, intake/output) accurately and timely to support patient monitoring and clinical decision-making
  • Perform patient rounding according to organizational standards to reinforce safety, therapeutic structure, and recovery-focused engagement
  • Observe patient behavior and milieu activity and communicate relevant updates to the Charge Nurse to support early identification of concerns and appropriate interventions
  • Provide recovery-oriented support and therapeutic engagement by modeling healthy coping strategies and reinforcing program philosophy with patients and families
  • Facilitate patient discussion groups related to key steps in recovery as assigned, supporting peer connection and treatment participation
  • Complete documentation (progress notes and therapeutic environment flow sheets) after completing required in-services, under the supervision of the Charge Nurse, to ensure accurate and compliant records

Scope and Impact:

  • Contribute to patient safety and unit stability by maintaining consistent presence, using supportive communication, and reinforcing structured routines in a fast-paced care setting
  • Escalate changes in patient condition or safety concerns promptly to the Charge Nurse, supporting timely clinical evaluation and continuity of care
  • Support a therapeutic environment by assisting with patient engagement throughout the shift, helping reduce barriers to participation in recovery activities
  • Maintain a clean, organized unit environment by completing assigned housekeeping tasks (e.g., wiping surfaces, emptying waste, refrigerator defrosting) to support infection prevention and patient experience
  • Provide team support for clinical workflow by filing, organizing charts, and preparing admission/transfer/discharge documentation to sustain unit efficiency and readiness

Compliance and Professional:

  • Protect patient privacy and confidentiality by following HIPAA requirements and using appropriate discretion in all verbal, written, and electronic communications
  • Adhere to infection prevention and patient safety standards including hand hygiene, environmental cleaning expectations, and required personal protective equipment (PPE) use per organizational policy
  • Complete required training, in-services, and competency validations within established timelines, including documentation standards for progress notes and therapeutic environment flow sheets
  • Use professional, respectful communication and boundaries to support a recovery-focused, trauma-informed environment for patients and families
  • Perform duties in accordance with established escalation pathways and work under the direction of nursing leadership to ensure safe, consistent care delivery
  • Safeguard sensitive data by following established security policies and procedures, using systems responsibly, and promptly reporting potential security incidents, risks, or policy violations
  • As applicable to your role, support cybersecurity and data protection requirements throughout the supplier lifecycle by coordinating vendor risk assessments, monitoring third-party compliance, and promptly reporting identified supply chain or cybersecurity risks

Additional Expectations:

  • Promote a culture of connection and belonging by collaborating with colleagues and contributing to a supportive team environment where every connection matters
  • Accept additional responsibilities assigned to meet patient care needs and support overall unit operations
  • Demonstrate UHS Values of Compassion, Trust, Respect, Teamwork, and Innovation in all daily work and interactions
  • Execute responsibilities in accordance with organizational policies, procedures, and applicable regulations
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required to meet department and organizational needs

Position Qualifications

Required:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Preferred:

  • Up to 1 year of direct experience performing the exact or very similar duties required by the job within the same role or function
  • Up to 1 year of customer/patient-facing experience directly interacting and communicating with the public
  • Up to 1 year of technical/systems experience using specialized tools, software, or equipment required for the role
  • Up to 1 year of experience in the same work environment or setting (hospital, practice, department/division)

United Health Services (UHS) is a locally owned, not-for-profit healthcare system in New York’s Southern Tier comprising four hospitals, long-term care and home care services, and physician practices in Broome and surrounding counties. UHS provides healthcare and medical services for two-thirds of the region’s population, produces $1.3 billion a year in total economic impact, and boasts a workforce of more than 6,300 employees and providers.

title: Fabricator – Second Shift
description:
Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

YOU

As a 2nd shift Fabricator, you will be responsible for bending, seating, flanging and top flanging material according to work order and production drawing specifications in such a manner as to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and lean production goals. The shift hours are 2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m., and the role is eligible for a $0.75 shift differential.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (% of Time)

Machine Set‑Up, Programming, and Operation – 40%

  • Independently performs set‑up, programming, troubleshooting, and operation of one or more production machines, including: Automatic presses, Turret presses, and Utility presses (shears, press brakes, manual presses)
  • Ensure machines run efficiently, safely, and to required specifications.

Fabrication and Layout Work – 25%

  • Performs layout, fabrication, and assembly tasks needed to meet production requirements.
  • Creates and fabricates customer specialty items when required.

Troubleshooting and Quality Control – 15%

  • Diagnoses mechanical and process issues with equipment or fabricated parts.
  • Verifies accuracy of completed work using measuring tools and quality standards.

Equipment Maintenance and Safety Compliance – 10%

  • Conducts basic equipment care, cleaning, and preventative maintenance.
  • Follows all safety, operational, and company production procedures.

Training and Team Support – 10%

  • Trains and assists other production employees.
  • Provides guidance on machine operations, safety practices, and fabrication techniques

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too:

  • High School Diploma/GED preferred.
  • Mathematical Reasoning: Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • Attention to Detail: Attention to detail and ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Communication Skills: Applies customer service principles and processes on the job and with others. Speaks in the most effective way to relay information. Listens and asks questions to ensure understanding.
  • Safety: Able to consistently prioritize safety by demonstrating a safe work practices by promoting a safe and clean work environment.
  • Self-Management Skills: Uses time efficiently to complete tasks.
  • Quality Standards Knowledge: Area Expert at understanding the quality standards and quality control processes.
  • Ability to Work Independently: Follows both written and oral instructions, including safety guidelines, work instructions, and company policies.
  • Production and Processing: Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.
  • Operation Monitoring: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

TRAVEL REQUIRED

This position requires domestic travel up to 5% of the time.

WORK STATUS & LOCATION

This full-time, non-exempt position is located in Riverside CA.

RELOCATION

Relocation is not available for this position.

PAY

$20.75 – $25.40 / hour


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, see, talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. This role operates large equipment while standing for approximately 8-12 hours, regularly twisting and bending in a repetitive motion. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may frequently lift, carry, push and pull materials and objects weighing up to 50 pounds, and heavier weights with proper equipment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The job may risk exposure to heat and/or cold, loud noise levels, vibration, and moving mechanical parts.

We recognize and reward employees with a carefully designed and comprehensive rewards package, including competitive compensation, quarterly bonuses or commission and first-rate benefits. May exclude some positions, such as seasonal jobs.

  • Quarterly Bonuses/Commission: You will be eligible for either a bonus or commission, paid on a quarterly basis. We believe all employees affect customers, sales and revenue — directly or indirectly – and should be rewarded by sharing the company profits.
  • Benefits: We provide a wide range of benefits for eligible full-time employees including: medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, employee stock purchase and bonus plans, pay for holidays, vacation, sick days, funerals and jury duty, years of service awards, employee discounts, employee referral bonuses, charitable contribution matching, education reimbursement and more. description:

We strive to be an employer of choice and establish a reputation for being a talent rich organization where Associates can grow their career caring for others. For over a century, we’ve served the health care needs of the people of Memphis and the Mid-South.

The Physician is responsible for working with the nursing staff and physicians to provide comprehensive medical services and ensure the safety and quality of clinical care in the physician practice and Methodist LeBonheur Hospitals. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.


Working at MLH means carrying the mission forward of caring for our community and impacting the lives of patients in every way through compassion, a deliberate focus on service expectations and a consistent thriving for excellence.

A Brief Overview
The Physician is responsible for working with the nursing staff and physicians to provide comprehensive medical services and ensure the safety and quality of clinical care in the physician practice and Methodist LeBonheur Hospitals. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.

What you will do
  • Provides and manages direct patient care, including physical examinations, evaluations and assessments using best practices to diagnose and treat patients.
  • Prescribes pharmaceuticals, other medications, and treatment regimens as appropriate to assessed medical conditions.
  • Refers patients to specialists and to relevant patient care components as appropriate.
  • Evaluates patient for need for and level of prescription medicines required and considers alternative techniques for patient care.
  • Manages the daily operations of a specific medical program, patient care unit, or research function.
  • Directs and coordinates the patient care activities of nursing and support staff as required.
  • Follows established departmental policies, procedures, and objectives, continuous quality improvement objectives, and safety, environmental, and/or infection control standards.
  • Participates in specified health promotion, education and/or prevention programs.
  • Explains procedures and discusses test results or prescribed treatments with patients and their families as needed.
  • Orders, performs, and interprets tests, and analyzes records, reports, and examination information to diagnose patients’ condition.
  • Maintains accurate and timely completion of all documentation within 3 days of visit or discharge.
  • Coordinates work with nurses, social workers, rehabilitation therapists, pharmacists, psychologists and other health care providers.
  • Supports call coverage for the practice and hospitals.
  • Maintains productivity at acceptable levels.
  • Focuses on high patient and family satisfaction and retention.
  • Develops strong partnership with fellow physicians and support staff.

Education/Formal Training Requirements
  • Required - MD/DO Medicine

Work Experience Requirements
  • Required - No prior work experience

Licenses and Certifications Requirements
  • Required - Medical Doctor - Tennessee - Tennessee State Board of Medical Examiners
  • Required - AOA Board Certified Physician-Specialty - American Osteopathic Association
  • Preferred - Medical Doctor - Mississippi - Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure
  • Preferred - Medical Doctor - Arkansas - Arkansas State Medical Board
  • Preferred - Osteopathic Physician Tennessee - Tennessee Board of Osteophathic Examination
  • Preferred - National Board Certified Physician - The National Board of Physicians and Surgeons
  • Preferred - Board Certified Physician - American Board of Medical Specialties
  • Preferred - Board Certified DO - National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners (NBOME)

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Knowledge of legal and ethical standards for the delivery of medical care.
  • Knowledge of related accreditation and certification requirements.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Knowledge of community medical diagnostic and patient care services in area of medical expertise.
  • Ability to supervise, advise, and train clinical professionals and/or students in areas of expertise.
  • Knowledge of current principles, methods and procedures for the delivery of medical evaluation, diagnosis and treatment in area of expertise.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain quality, safety, and/or infection control standards.
  • Ability to observe, assess, and record symptoms, reactions, and progress.
  • Knowledge of relevant drugs and non-pharmaceutical patient care aids and ability to prescribe dosages and instruct patients in correct usage.

Supervision Provided by this Position
  • Administrator, nurse practitioner, and support staff

Physical Demands
  • Must be physically and mentally able, with or without reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of the position without endangering the health and safety of self and others.
  • The physical activities of this position may include climbing, pushing, standing, hearing, walking, reaching, grasping, kneeling, stooping, and repetitive motion.
  • Must have good balance and coordination.
  • The physical requirements of this position are: medium work - exerting up to 50 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 25 lbs. of force frequently.
  • The Associate is required to have close visual acuity including color, depth perception, and field of vision to perform an activity, such as assessing patients, preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; or extensive reading.
  • Frequent invasive and non-invasive patient contact.
  • Exposure to patient body fluids as well as exposure to hazardous or poisonous materials.
  • Ability to react quickly to emergency situations.

Our Associates are passionate about what they do, the service they provide and the patients they serve. We value family, team and a Power of One culture that requires commitment to the highest standards of care and unity.


Boasting one of the South's largest medical centers, Memphis blends a friendly community, a thriving and growing downtown, and a low cost of living. We see each day as a new opportunity to make a difference in the lives of the people in our community.

title: Parts Handler (Swing)
description:
Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

YOU

As a Parts Handler, you will hang, remove, move, inspect, and package parts to keep production flowing efficiently and safely. You’ll work independently, maintain quality standards, and support LEAN initiatives while helping the team meet production goals.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Hang and remove parts from the powder coat line, adjusting hooks and ensuring continuous line flow. (40%)

Package finished products, apply labels, palletize goods, and maintain a clean, organized work area. (25%)

Perform quality inspections using production drawings and specifications; visually inspect for defects and communicate issues to leadership. (20%)

Move parts and materials using carts, pallet jacks, and forklifts; use computers, scanners, and label machines to complete work orders. (10%)

Train employees on equipment and processes used in the Parts Handler role. (5%)

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too:

  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to perform frequent physical activities including walking (normal, uneven, or slippery surfaces), standing, bending, kneeling, squatting, climbing, twisting, reaching, and repetitive hand/foot motions.
  • Basic English reading, writing, and math skills.
  • Ability to read blueprints and identify BOM information on work orders.
  • Experience using measuring tools such as protractors, squares, and tape measures; understanding acute and obtuse angles.
  • Knowledge of production processes, quality control, and equipment operation.
  • Ability to stay focused and work at a fast pace while maintaining quality standards.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to ask questions when needed.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, see, talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. This role operates large equipment while standing for approximately 8-12 hours, regularly twisting and bending in a repetitive motion. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may frequently lift, carry, push and pull materials and objects weighing up to 50 pounds, and heavier weights with proper equipment

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The job may risk exposure to heat and/or cold, loud noise levels, vibration, and moving mechanical parts.

TRAVEL REQUIRED

This job does not require travel.

WORK STATUS & LOCATION

This full-time, non-exempt, Union position is located in Stockton, CA. It is not eligible for remote work. This is a Swing shift position (3:30pm – 12:00am).

RELOCATION

Relocation is not available for this position.

PAY

$18.00 / hour


REWARDS AT SIMPSON STRONG-TIE

We recognize and reward employees with a carefully designed and comprehensive rewards package, including competitive compensation, quarterly bonuses or commission and first-rate benefits. May exclude some positions, such as seasonal jobs.

  • Quarterly Bonuses/Commission: You will be eligible for either a bonus or commission, paid on a quarterly basis. We believe all employees affect customers, sales and revenue — directly or indirectly – and should be rewarded by sharing the company profits.
  • Benefits: We provide a wide range of benefits for eligible full-time employees including: medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, employee stock purchase and bonus plans, pay for holidays, vacation, sick days, funerals and jury duty, years of service awards, employee discounts, employee referral bonuses, charitable contribution matching, education reimbursement and more. title: Refinery Operator-1
description:
At Richardson International, being truly invested is at the heart of everything we do. For over 165 years, Richardson has been dedicated to Canadian agriculture. Recognized as a global leader in agriculture and food processing, Richardson is one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies with over 4,000 employees across Canada, the U.S., the U.K., and Europe. At Richardson, we are committed to enhancing our facilities and services and investing in our people and our communities.


Richardson Oilseed is one of Canada’s oldest and largest fully-integrated oilseed processing and packaging operations with three facilities across Canada. In addition to producing bulk canola oil and meal, our food products division produces a wide variety of canola-based margarines, oils, and shortenings for the industrial, retail and foodservice markets.


Working with Richardson opens the door to a world of possibility. We currently have an opportunity for a Refinery Operator at our Yorkton, SK - Oilseed location. The Refinery Operator is responsible for the operation and monitoring of all refining and bleaching equipment and chemical offloading.


Responsibilities:

  • Operate plant equipment within a specific range of process parameters
  • Responsible for offloading of clay cars and ensure track out procedure is followed
  • Sample and test product as required
  • Complete operator log and daily production reports
  • Maintain equipment in good operating condition (general lubrication)
  • Report and document maintenance, electrical, automation, process, safety issues and downtime in action list books
  • Monitor and adjust all mechanical equipment to ensure production plan and quality is maintained.
  • Record keeping and logging of all data as required.
  • Clean bleaching filters as required
  • Add clay, citric acid and filter aid to post bleach batches as specified by production schedule
  • Troubleshoot process upsets
  • Confined space entry is required
  • Must maintain good attendance and meet performance expectations
  • Must maintain a clean and orderly work environment
  • Responsible for housekeeping in all areas (including daily/weekly/monthly/yearly)
  • Understand and comply with all workplace health and safety requirements, company policies and procedures and general workplace rules
  • Participate in the day-to-day health and safety program by working in a safe manner at all times:
  • Always using the required personal protective equipment
  • Ensuring that authorized work is completed safely
  • Utilizing required controls to prevent risk of exposure to hazards
  • Participating actively in incident investigations, training, and other health and safety initiatives
  • Reporting all unsafe acts and conditions and all incidents, near misses and workplace injuries/illnesses as per company procedure
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Grade 12 or equivalent
  • Must have mechanical aptitude
  • Excellent written, documentation and verbal communication skills
  • Must be willing to work shifts, overtime and cross train in other positions
  • Must be willing to work independently and be accountable for all work hours
  • Must have an excellent attendance record (less than 4 days absent in the past 12 months)
  • Demonstrated ability to perform responsibilities according to Health and Safety policies and procedures
  • Automated process experience an asset
  • General Health – must be physically capable for all aspects of the job
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and team work ability are strong assets

Richardson International provides an excellent compensation package consisting of competitive salary, pension, a flexible benefits plan and training and career development opportunities.


Interested candidates should click the Apply icon to apply online by October 13, 2026.


Richardson International values diversity in the workplace. Women, Indigenous Peoples, Visible Minorities, and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify.

title: Clinical Unit Leader - Emergency Department - St. Charles Hospital
description:
Thank you for considering a career at Mercy Health!

36

Mercy Health

Intro paragraph

As a faith-based and patient-focused organization, Mercy Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of all people in mind, body and spirit through exceptional patient care. Success in this goal requires a culture of compassion, collaboration, excellence and respect. Mercy Health seeks people that are committed to our values of compassion, human dignity, integrity, service and stewardship to create an environment where associates want to work and help communities thrive.

Clinical Unit Leader – St. Charles Hospital

Job Summary:

The Lead RN/Charge Nurse is responsible for coordinating patient care on a designated unit. In collaboration with the Clinical Manager, this role uses nursing process and clinical knowledge to coordinate members of the health care team to develop and sustain an environment that promotes excellence in clinical practice and customer satisfaction, while striving for optimal efficiency and productivity of all resources.

Essential Functions:

  • Adjusts the schedule and patient assignments to accommodate changes in acuity, patient population, resources & care design.
  • Provides guidance of staff, clinical support, and oversees responsibility for the unit in the absence of the unit leader.
  • Maintains current knowledge of environmental safety standards and infection control; Utilizes appropriate supplies and equipment.
  • Communicates effectively with patients and their families regarding nursing interventions and plan of care.
  • Rounds on patients to evaluate safety, quality, and patient experience.
  • Serves as a resource to staff, patients, and family members to ensure effective communication.
  • Functions as a clinical resource and role model for staff. May serve as a preceptor.
  • Actively involved in interprofessional collaborative practice within the care delivery system to ensure care coordination and continuity of care and optimal patient experience.
  • Communicates effectively and follows through with other departments as necessary to resolve operational problems.
  • Participates in the ongoing quality monitoring and performance improvement program through monitoring activities, evaluation of unit-based results, suggestions for studies.
  • Facilitates appropriate patient placement and safe, efficient admission, transfer, and discharge processes.
  • Provides feedback and mentoring to nursing and support staff.
  • Creates an environment of teamwork, mutual respect, conflict management. Fosters and encourages open communication and conflict resolution among staff members. Manages conflict in a timely, direct and positive manner.
  • Supports mission and vision of the organization and adheres to BSMH policies.
  • BSMH nurses are expected to practice and deliver care in accordance with the core concepts and intention of the BSMH Nursing Professional Practice Model

title: Lead Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist management with the operations of the store by performing clerk duties in the designated department (grocery or freight), leading by example, and assisting the department manager in general department operations as directed. Answer customer questions and complaints in a professional manner and assure all customers receive fast, friendly service. Perform the duties of a grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker in addition to assisting assigned employees in the performance of their tasks as appropriate, including notifying them of their breaks and lunches. Performs other related work.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve and thank customers. Maintains and encourages an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Provides customer service by performing the duties of a clerk in the designated department (grocery or freight). **Refer to Grocery Clerk, Cashier/Checker and/or Freight Stocker job descriptions for complete list of responsibilities.
  • Performs a lead role in customer service which may include handling customer complaints and requests, approving checks, selling gift certificates, issuing refunds, receiving returned check payments and answering any questions the customer must have.
  • Continuously monitors area activities, including customer traffic flow, coverage of checkout lanes, etc.
  • Maintains cleanliness and eye-appeal of work area, storage area, equipment and retail displays according to company policy and legal regulations; and cleans work area by mopping, sweeping, taking out garbage, etc.
  • Ensures the department/area of responsibility is kept clear of excess carts, baskets, garbage, etc.
  • Monitors arrivals, breaks, lunches and departures of employees in area of responsibility. Communicates with immediate supervisor regularly.
  • Assists immediate supervisor as needed or directed.
  • Assists clerks by providing direction and leadership, demonstrating and performing clerk responsibilities and assigned tasks, and answering employee questions.
  • May monitor cashier money handling procedures and assists with scan system procedures (i.e. UPC codes not on file, scan pricing errors, etc.).
  • May fill department racks/shelves, displays, coolers, handle and use cleaning materials, department machines and equipment, pull cardboard and face the wall and aisles, perform cashiering duties, perform other duties as needed or directed.

  • Stocks and rotates merchandise in any area of the store as needed.

Requirements

Education:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Experience:

  • Communicating clearly and professionally, utilizing excellent verbal, written and inter-personal communication skills, establishing and maintaining a good rapport with co-workers, supervisors, vendors, customers and others.
  • Providing leadership, exhibiting interpersonal skills by maintaining composure and professionally addressing difficult and sometimes angry individuals including customers, vendors and co-workers.
  • Applying clear understanding of overall company practices, including in-depth knowledge of polices/procedures, in order to effectively judge and react to customer activity.
  • Demonstrating initiative and self-direction to perform a variety of simultaneous skills (multi-tasking).
  • Conducting visual inspections, reading reports, computer printouts, register and computer screens, etc.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, multiply and divide) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately with honesty and integrity.
  • In Montana and Oregon the minimum age is 18 years old. All other states the minimum age is 21 years old.

Ability to:

  • Consistently provide world class customer service to internal and external customers.
  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Perform all duties described in the appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker).
  • Understand overall company practices through previous experience in designated department (grocery or freight) or equivalent.
  • Properly use cleaning chemicals in accordance with manufacture’s guidelines and instructions.
  • Properly handle food products per State and County laws, and WinCo standards.
  • Reach, lift and maneuver objects of varying dimensions and weights up to 50 lbs. frequently.
  • Stand for long periods of time, walk and move rapidly, bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, machines, equipment and work aides.
  • Understand state & federal regulations if certification is needed.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must meet age requirements listed above.
  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Refer to appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker) for complete list.

Classification

Rehabilitation Counselor

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To perform responsible counseling duties in connection with a statewide program of vocational rehabilitation of the physically and/or mentally handicapped; to perform disability determinations in connection with the preservation of old age and survivors insurance benefits; and to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Works under the close supervision of a superior; work is reviewed in process and upon completion for adequacy and conformance to provisions of laws, rules and regulations.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Usually none.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • To perform responsible counseling duties in connection with a statewide program of vocational rehabilitation of the physically and/or mentally handicapped.
  • To perform disability determinations in connections with the preservation of old age and survivors insurance benefits.
  • To interview applicants in order to obtain complete social, educational, medical, and occupational history and to do follow-up on cases as required.
  • To evaluate all case information obtained to determine the applicability of the rehabilitation services to the clients, or to adjudicate disability insurance claims.
  • To arrange for medical diagnosis, medical and surgical treatment and physical, therapeutic, and psychiatric treatment as needed.
  • To make decisions on eligibility of disability insurance claims based on medical information and federal guidelines.
  • To arrange courses of vocational training and programs of financial aid.
  • To maintain close contracts with employers and employment services for the purpose of locating employment possibilities for handicapped persons.
  • To check periodically on cases during the rehabilitation program with administrators and staffs of public and private agencies, academic institutions. hospitals, physicians, and other cooperating agencies and individuals.
  • To keep case records and prepare detailed written reports.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGES, SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A familiarity with the approved methods and procedures used in vocational or disability examination; a familiarity with educational and vocational training opportunities, facilities for medical, psychiatric, and related treatment or diagnosis, and other social agencies in the community; the ability to analyze occupations as to physical requirements and suitability as employment for handicapped persons; the ability to conduct personal fact-finding interviews; the ability to prepare reports; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Such as may have been gained through: graduation from college of recognized standing with specialization in Sociology, or Psychology, or Vocational Guidance, or Education; and

Experience: Such as may have been gained through: employment for in the fields of Education, Employment Placement, Public Welfare, Public Health, or in a placement or vocational adjustment problems.

Or, any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

Supplemental Information

Determines medical eligibility of children and adults applying for cash benefits under SSI/SSDI based on Federal regulations; obtains/analyzes medical records; processes a workload in an electronic environment. The Rehabilitation Counselor is the front line position at the RIDDS, handling all aspects of the case decision making process. They interact directly with the applicant to ensure that all of the needed information is obtained to make an accurate determination. The position requires extensive training in programmatic policies as well as specialized education related to medical and vocational documentation requirements of the Social Security administration (SSA) disability program. If found to satisfy the disability criteria, the applicant could be eligible to receive both cash and medical coverage

Applicant will need to undergo a Federal Background check including Credit check, BCI, and interviews with investigators.

A conditional job offer and access to Social Security Administration’s (SSA’s) systems, data, information, and/or premises are contingent upon you passing the SSA suitability process.
