title: Engineer (Winter 2026/Spring 2027 Graduates)
description:
The Role


The Engineer role is your opportunity to build a comprehensive understanding of our business from day one.


From formal training to mentorship, you’ll develop the technical skills, leadership instincts, and business acumen of seasoned experts. Atkinson’s network of companies spans every stage of construction, giving you room to explore, specialize, and grow.


The Engineer provides administrative and technical services in the fields of scheduling, cost engineering, subcontract coordination, and general project administration. Along with job site project managers and superintendents, engineers have responsibilities in overall project oversight and may be assigned to a particular section, subcontractor, or other facet(s) of the project.


Responsibilities


Your first few years with Atkinson will be defined by dynamic Career Building Experiences, where you will be exposed to:


Project Management: Working in project management gives you an understanding of the day-to-day and long-term business and financial management associated with construction projects.

  • Financial Management - Review gross billings, track change orders, and subcontractor requisitions
  • Document Control - Manage the submittals, RFI, and material tracking process
  • Support Crews and Trades - Stay ahead of the crew's needs, making sure they are efficient in their work

Field Management: Learn the intricacies of the building process, assist in site logistics, and ensure quality and safety on our job sites.

  • Quality Control and Safety - Monitor work with emphasis on quality and safety
  • Project Schedule - Assist with schedule management and site logistics
  • Critical Thinking - Resolve unforeseen challenges within installation, schedule, and coordination

Project Development: Understand how we acquire new work, develop winning strategies, and build strong client relationships through budgeting, estimating, and purchasing.

  • Budgeting - Review initial contract documents, solicit, and provide preliminary evaluations of subcontractor bids
  • Estimating - Perform quantity takeoffs, prepare the overall bid proposal, and quantify labor and material prices required for projects

Basic Qualifications

  • Pursuing an undergraduate degree (or equivalent) or a master's degree, with an expected graduation in Winter 2025 or Spring 2026
  • Interest and passion for the construction industry


What a Successful Candidate Looks Like


We look for individuals who embody these core principles:

  • Enthusiasm & Drive: Be punctual and dedicated, staying until work is done. Arrive early for meetings and events. Be a proactive team player – ask how you can help and be present. Take initiative, represent the company professionally (dress, demeanor), and build trust with your team, clients, and stakeholders. Proactively seek ways to contribute to team success and always maintain a positive attitude.
  • Delivery & Performance: Reliably meet the expectations of your role and commitments. Understand and follow Atkinson's standard procedures. Take on new responsibilities, dig into the details, and bring solutions to problems. Take ownership, be accountable, and demonstrate responsiveness with a sense of urgency.
  • Learning & Growth: Immerse yourself in Atkinson's culture, your team, and your community. Fulfill Atkinson Civil College learning requirements. Be engaged, accountable, and self-directed in your learning – be curious! Continuously build your technical expertise and grow your business acumen.

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.


The Physical Side of the Role: This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.


Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Atkinson Construction's safety policies and procedures and all applicable laws at all locations.


Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.


A Drug-Free Workplace: Atkinson promotes a drug-free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

Atkinson offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role, the base salary range is $87,500 - $100,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: Tech Lead – Agentic Product Operations & Reliability
description:
Artificial Intelligence is changing how ING delivers, operates, and continuously improves products. As Tech Lead for Agentic Product Operations & Reliability, you will build and lead the engineering capability responsible for running ING's next generation of agentic products at scale.


You will establish the Run organization for Agentic Products, ensuring AI-powered products are reliable, observable, compliant, secure, and continuously improving in production. Working at the intersection of AI, platform engineering, operations, and product delivery, you will help define how ING operates agentic systems across countries and business domains for years to come.



The team

You will be part of the Agentic Products Delivery organization within Data & Analytics. The team is responsible for operating, monitoring, supporting, and improving a growing portfolio of agentic products used across ING.

You will work closely with Product Engineering teams, Platform Engineering, Risk, Security, Architecture, Operations, and business stakeholders to establish the operational foundations required for scalable and reusable agentic product delivery.


We work in a BizDevOps environment with end-to-end accountability for the reliability, performance, resilience, and continuous improvement of agentic products.



Roles and responsibilities

As Tech Lead, you will:

  • Lead the establishment of the Agentic Product Run capability and define its long-term operating model.
  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing engineering team focused on production operations, reliability, and service excellence.
  • Define and implement operational standards for agentic products, including observability, incident management, problem management, support processes, and platform health monitoring.
  • Drive production readiness requirements and ensure new products can be operated safely and efficiently before entering production.
  • Make sure agentic products follow SLOs, SLAs, reliability targets, operational KPIs, and performance dashboards.
  • Define support and escalation models across product teams, countries, and shared platform teams.
  • Lead root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives to improve product reliability, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Drive automation of operational processes including monitoring, alerting, self-healing capabilities, and operational analytics.
  • Ensure compliance with ING security, risk, governance, and non-functional requirements.
  • Partner with Product Engineering and Platform Engineering teams to embed operability, resilience, and supportability into product design from day one.
  • Establish governance and operational controls for AI model performance, agent behavior, auditability, and human-in-the-loop operations.
  • Build reusable run capabilities and operational patterns that can be applied consistently across the growing portfolio of agentic products.
  • Act as the technical authority for operational excellence within the Agentic Products Delivery organization.



How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

You are successful in this role when you:

  • Create a scalable and sustainable Run capability that supports rapid growth of agentic products across ING.
  • Demonstrate strong technical leadership across engineering, operations, platform, and AI disciplines.
  • Build operational excellence into every aspect of the product lifecycle.
  • Balance innovation with reliability, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Drive stakeholder alignment across business, technology, operations, and risk domains.
  • Create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

Experience we value

  • Proven experience as a Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, Site Reliability Lead, Platform Lead, or similar leadership role.
  • Strong experience operating large-scale digital, cloud-native, automation, AI, or data-driven products in production environments.
  • Experience building and leading operational or reliability engineering teams.
  • Deep understanding of observability, monitoring, incident management, problem management, and operational governance.
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, agentic systems, intelligent automation, or complex digital workflow platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, and modern engineering practices.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with security, risk, and compliance controls.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic operational capabilities.


Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.


The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract
  • Pension scheme
  • 13th month salary
  • 8% Holiday payment
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues


About us
Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward?

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.



Questions?

title: Plant Operator
description:
Oxy produces, markets and transports oil and natural gas to maximize value and provide resources fundamental to life. The company leverages its global leadership in carbon management to advance lower-carbon technologies and products. Headquartered in Houston, Oxy primarily operates in the United States, Middle East and North Africa. To learn more, visit Oxy

Oxy strives to attract and retain talented employees by investing in their professional development and providing rewarding opportunities for personal growth. Our goal is to meet the highest employer standards by ensuring the health and safety of our employees, protecting the environment and positively impacting our communities where we do business.

The Plant Operator is responsible for safely operating, monitoring, and maintaining plant equipment and processes to ensure reliable, efficient, and compliant facility operations. This role supports daily production goals by performing equipment inspections, responding to alarms or abnormal conditions, documenting operating data, and working closely with maintenance, supervision, and other operations personnel. The Plant Operator is expected to follow established procedures, maintain a strong safety focus, and contribute to continuous improvement across the facility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate plant equipment, systems, and controls in accordance with standard operating procedures, production requirements, and safety expectations.
  • Monitor process conditions such as pressures, temperatures, levels, flows, alarms, and equipment status to maintain stable and efficient operations.
  • Perform routine rounds, inspections, and field checks to identify leaks, abnormal vibrations, unusual noises, equipment failures, or unsafe conditions.
  • Start up, shut down, and adjust equipment as directed by operating procedures, supervision, or changing process conditions.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, equipment issues, process upsets, and emergency situations while following established response procedures.
  • Record operating data, readings, inspections, work activities, and equipment conditions accurately in logs, reports, or electronic systems.
  • Communicate operational status, concerns, maintenance needs, and shift turnover information clearly with team members and supervisors.
  • Assist with troubleshooting process or equipment problems and coordinate with maintenance personnel to support repairs and reliability improvements.
  • Support lockout/tagout, permitting, line breaks, confined space entry, and other safe work practices as required.
  • Maintain housekeeping standards and keep work areas clean, organized, and free of unnecessary hazards.
  • Participate in safety meetings, training, emergency drills, hazard recognition activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Follow all company policies, regulatory requirements, environmental standards, and site-specific procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Previous experience in plant operations, production, manufacturing, oil and gas, chemical processing, utilities, or a related industrial environment preferred.
  • Ability to read, understand, and follow operating procedures, safety policies, equipment manuals, and work instructions.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and ability to recognize abnormal equipment or process conditions.
  • Ability to use radios, computers, log sheets, electronic work systems, and basic Microsoft Office tools as required.
  • Valid driver’s license may be required depending on site responsibilities.
  • Ability to work rotating shifts, nights, weekends, holidays, overtime, and callouts as business needs require.

Preferred Skills and Competencies

  • Strong commitment to safety, environmental compliance, and operational discipline.
  • Good troubleshooting, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and focused during abnormal or emergency situations.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work effectively with operations, maintenance, contractors, and supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail when recording readings, completing checklists, and monitoring process changes.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and work independently with limited supervision.
  • Willingness to learn new systems, technologies, procedures, and operating practices.

Safety and Environmental Expectations

The Plant Operator is expected to perform all work in a safe, responsible, and environmentally compliant manner. This includes identifying hazards, stopping unsafe work when necessary, using required personal protective equipment, following permit and isolation procedures, reporting incidents or near misses, and supporting a culture where safety and environmental stewardship are core priorities.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb stairs and ladders, bend, reach, lift, and work in an industrial plant environment.
  • Ability to work outdoors and indoors in varying weather conditions, temperatures, noise levels, and operational environments.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment, which may include hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, flame-resistant clothing, respirator, or other site-required PPE.
  • Ability to lift or move materials within company and regulatory guidelines.
  • Ability to respond to alarms, equipment issues, and emergency situations as required by the position.

Work Environment

This position typically works in an industrial plant or production environment that may include operating equipment, process units, control rooms, field locations, mechanical systems, and outdoor areas. The role may require shift work, overtime, emergency response, and coordination with multiple departments to maintain safe and reliable operations.

Performance Expectations

  • Operate equipment safely and reliably while minimizing downtime and process interruptions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and effective shift-to-shift communication.
  • Identify and report hazards, equipment concerns, and improvement opportunities in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned areas, daily responsibilities, and site expectations.
  • Support team goals by contributing to safe production, environmental compliance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Recruitment Fraud

It has come to our attention various individuals and/or organizations are contacting people falsely pretending to recruit on behalf of Oxy. Please be aware that these recruiting scams and communications do not originate nor are they associated with our recruitment process. All Oxy job postings and offers will require a completed application through our company website.

title: Senior Researcher, Product Experience, Games Discovery
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Location: This role can be based in our Los Angeles, Los Gatos or New York office in a flexible hybrid model. Some travel will be required.

Our Product Consumer Insights team occupies a central role in uncovering the evolving needs of our members, generating insights at each step of their product experience to drive more business impact and member joy. Netflix is expanding beyond shows and movies into games, advertising, live sports, live events, and more. This Senior Researcher role will focus on evaluating, prioritizing, and shaping fast-moving, newer company-wide bets, with the aim of continuing to delight members in our mission to entertain the world.

We are looking for a seasoned researcher who has deep experience leading innovative, zero-to-one research in new spaces, with demonstrable impact on a global scale. You will be responsible for defining, leading, analyzing, and socializing research studies that generate insights to empower business and product decisions across the company. You’ll partner with cross-functional teams who are passionate about delivering the most engaging, innovative, and inclusive experiences.

In this role, you will:

  • Identify, prioritize, lead, and execute on research roadmaps that generate insights to inform product strategies across the company.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams at the intersection of Product and Content, including Product Innovation, Design, Data Science, Engineering, Content Strategy, Product Marketing, and Communications to proactively develop research initiatives.

  • Define, design, execute, and socialize a range of research studies that build a strong understanding of existing and future audiences and their experiences around the world.

  • Identify best practices in existing and emerging research methodologies.

About you:

  • At least 7+ years of demonstrable experience in product research and/or user experience (UX) research, with particular experience designing and leading end-to-end, complex quantitative research studies.

  • A balance of creative and analytical skills with the ability to proactively define research questions, identify appropriate methods, execute studies, and synthesize findings with statistical rigor.

  • Strong communicator with a bias toward action to proactively collaborate with multiple teams across the company.

  • Passionate about translating findings into actionable strategic business recommendations.

  • An advanced degree in psychology, social sciences, or a related field is preferred but not required.

  • Global research experience is highly preferred but not required.

  • Familiarity or experience with futurecasting, design strategy, innovation frameworks, and research in emergent areas is preferred but not required

  • Experience, passion and/or interest in games is preferred but not required

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $294,000.00 - $470,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

title: Tech Lead – Agentic Product Delivery
description:
Artificial Intelligence is transforming how ING operates, serves customers, and empowers employees. We are looking for a passionate and experienced Tech Lead to lead the engineering teams responsible for designing, building, and scaling Agentic Products across ING.


As Tech Lead for Agentic Product Delivery, you will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams that transform business opportunities into production-ready AI-powered products. You will drive the technical delivery of agentic solutions, establish engineering standards, and build reusable capabilities that enable ING to rapidly scale Agentic AI across countries, business domains, and customer journeys.


This is a unique opportunity to help shape ING's Agentic AI strategy and build the next generation of intelligent banking capabilities.


The team

You will be part of the Agentic Products Delivery organization within Data & Analytics.


The team is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering end-to-end agentic products that automate, augment, and optimize business processes across ING. We focus on building scalable products rather than one-off solutions, leveraging reusable platforms, common orchestration patterns, and shared AI capabilities.


Working in a BizDevOps environment, we take end-to-end ownership from ideation through deployment and transition into operations. We collaborate closely with Product Leads, Architects, Data Scientists, Platform Engineering, Security, Risk, and Operations teams to deliver secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions.


Roles and responsibilities

As Tech Lead, you will:

  • Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams delivering Agentic Products from concept to production.
  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for Agentic Product Delivery in alignment with business and technology strategy.
  • Translate business opportunities into scalable product architectures and delivery plans.
  • Drive engineering excellence through modern software engineering, AI engineering, and cloud-native development practices.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, and delivery standards for agentic product development.
  • Ensure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, compliant, and operationally ready.
  • Collaborate with Product Leads, Architects, Data Scientists, and Platform teams to deliver business outcomes at speed.
  • Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions and architectural challenges.
  • Drive adoption of shared platforms, orchestration capabilities, and foundational AI building blocks.
  • Coach and mentor engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure delivery teams effectively balance innovation, quality, risk management, and time-to-market objectives.
  • Contribute to ING's long-term vision for Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered banking.


How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

You are successful in this role when you:

  • Deliver scalable agentic products that create measurable business value.
  • Build high-performing engineering teams that consistently deliver quality outcomes.
  • Successfully translate emerging AI technologies into secure and production-ready solutions.
  • Create reusable technology capabilities that accelerate future product delivery.
  • Foster strong collaboration across business, technology, risk, and operational stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering practices, delivery performance, and product quality.


Key Skills & Qualifications

Leadership & Delivery

  • Proven experience leading software engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or product development teams.
  • Strong track record delivering complex enterprise technology products at scale.
  • Experience building and coaching high-performing engineering teams in Agile and DevOps environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to align business, technology, and risk stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and drive execution in fast-evolving technology domains.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and decision-making capabilities.

Agentic AI & Engineering Expertise

  • Experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, intelligent automation solutions, or agentic systems.
  • Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI orchestration patterns, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks.
  • Experience implementing human-in-the-loop, agent supervision, evaluation, monitoring, and governance capabilities.
  • Knowledge of AI risk management, model governance, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
  • Strong understanding of API-first architectures, event-driven systems, microservices, and distributed architectures.

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Experience with Google Cloud technologies relevant to Agentic AI delivery, including:

  • Vertex AI for model development, tuning, evaluation, deployment, and Agent Builder capabilities.
  • Gemini models and enterprise AI platform services.
  • Agent Development Kit (ADK) and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Cloud Run and GKE for scalable deployment of AI workloads and agent services.
  • BigQuery for data analytics, agent memory, and retrieval use cases.
  • AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, and vector-enabled databases supporting RAG architectures.
  • Pub/Sub and Eventarc for event-driven agent workflows.
  • Apigee for API management and enterprise integration.
  • Cloud Storage and Document AI for document-centric AI solutions.
  • Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, and operational observability for AI workloads.
  • IAM, Security Command Center, and cloud security controls supporting regulated environments.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong experience with software engineering, cloud-native development, CI/CD, DevOps, and platform engineering practices.
  • Experience building highly available, scalable, and resilient enterprise solutions.
  • Understanding of security-by-design, privacy-by-design, and operational resilience requirements.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployments.
  • Familiarity with observability, telemetry, monitoring, and engineering quality frameworks.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, AI engineering, or technology delivery.
  • Minimum 3 years of leadership experience as a Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, IT Lead, or equivalent role.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering cloud-native products within enterprise-scale environments.
  • Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry is advantageous.

Our biggest challenge to you

You will not simply deliver projects. You will help build ING's strategic Agentic Product capability.


By combining AI innovation, cloud engineering, and product-centric delivery, you will create scalable solutions that redefine how ING operates and accelerate the adoption of Agentic AI across the organization.



Rewards and benefits

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract
  • Pension scheme
  • 13th month salary
  • 8% Holiday payment
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities

About us

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

  • Within the Rhode Island Historical Preservation and Heritage Commission (RIHPHC), to perform difficult and complex professional historic preservation planning work within the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; to be responsible for the preparation of studies, plans, and reports, as well as phases of major projects; and/or to be responsible for the review of projects undertaken by other state or federal agencies, including the assessment of impacts on historic resources; and/or to be responsible for agency public information, events, programs; and to do related work as required.

title: Advisor - Computational Scientist, Multiscale & Multiphysics Modeling for Drug Delivery
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Organization Overview:

The Delivery, Device, and Connected Solutions (DDCS) organization supports the design, development, and commercialization of drug products and pharmaceutical delivery systems, including medical devices, combination products, and container closure systems.

This position sits within the Computational Modeling and Simulation team, which builds mechanistic understanding of the physicochemical processes underlying drug delivery. This role develops multiscale and multiphysics models — connecting molecular properties, formulation composition, and device and drug-delivery conditions to the safety and efficacy profiles through simulations of delivery, transport, absorption, and pharmacokinetics. These models generate the computational evidence that informs device-bridging strategy, delivery system design, and regulatory discussions.

Multiscale and Multiphysics modeling within DDCS supports drug delivery systems across multiple routes of administration. Primary focus areas include subcutaneous (SubQ) injection systems, where modeling connects formulation and device/injection parameters to tissue-level transport and systemic absorption. Additional routes include transdermal, nasal, and pulmonary, as well as local and central nervous system (CNS) delivery. The computational scientist will develop methodologies that scale across these modalities and length scales.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, execute, and interpret multiscale, multiphysics models that link molecular properties, formulation composition, and drug delivery/injection parameters to transport, absorption, and pharmacokinetic outcomes.

  • Apply and integrate computational approaches — such as CFD, FEA, particle transport, heat transfer, and species diffusion and reaction — as needed to characterize the continuum domain processes underlying drug delivery and absorption.

  • Build coupled modeling frameworks (e.g., mechanistic PBPK coupled with device- or tissue-level physics) that translate device and formulation inputs directly into patient-relevant pharmacokinetic predictions.

  • Develop platform tools built for a class of problems — reusable across molecules, doses, formulations, and delivery routes — rather than one-off, case-specific models.

  • Build automated modeling workflows, scripted pipelines, and differentiable calibration frameworks (e.g., gradient-based estimation, sensitivity and identifiability analysis) to improve efficiency and reproducibility.

  • Apply and develop AI/ML techniques, including surrogate modeling, reduced-order models, and physics-informed approaches, to accelerate simulation and design iteration.

  • Identify which physical or analytical measurements would resolve open modeling questions, and partner with analytical and clinical teams to define and integrate them.

  • Translate model outputs into decision-ready arguments — including device-bridging strategies, bioequivalence assessments, and delivery-system design recommendations — to support regulatory discussions.

  • Communicate modeling assumptions, methods, and results clearly to cross-functional and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Author and review technical reports and regulatory submission content related to computational modeling.

  • Contribute to model governance and credibility assessment frameworks aligned with ASME V&V 40.

  • Collaborate with Formulation Science, Device Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Manufacturing.

  • Maintain a quality mindset, proactively identifying issues and supporting continuous improvement.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Earned Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field with10+ years of relevant multiscale or multiphysics modeling experience.

  • Experience with mechanistic PBPK or compartmental modeling connecting formulation and device properties to absorption and pharmacokinetics. Strong foundation in transport phenomena, fluid mechanics, and heat and mass transfer in complex or biological media.

  • Scripting and customization of multiphysics solvers — for example, Abaqus Python scripting and user subroutines (Fortran), COMSOL LiveLink (MATLAB/Java), or Fluent UDFs (C).

  • Strong proficiency in Python for model automation, parametric studies, post-processing, and analysis (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, matplotlib), with disciplined use of version control and reproducible workflows.

  • Effective use of HPC environments (job scheduling with Slurm or equivalent, distributed solver execution

  • Experience building and calibrating models against experimental or clinical data, including sensitivity and identifiability analysis.

  • Experience with sensitivity analysis, uncertainty quantification, and surrogate or reduced-order modeling; differentiable programming frameworks such as JAX for inverse problems and physics-informed models.

Additional Preferences:

  • Earned PhD in a related field with 3+ years of research experience in relevant computational modeling

  • Working knowledge of ASME V&V 40 and experience developing credibility arguments for computational models.

  • Familiarity with regulatory guidance on computational modeling and simulation for medical devices and drug products.

  • Experience connecting molecular- or formulation-scale properties to device- and patient-scale outcomes through coupled, multiscale modeling.

  • Experience tissue mechanics and fluid-structure interaction in biological systems.

  • Demonstrated application of AI/ML techniques to simulation (surrogate models, reduced-order models, physics-informed neural networks).

  • Track record of translating model outputs into device bridging strategy, delivery system design, or regulatory arguments (e.g., biowaiver assessments).

  • Peer-reviewed publication record in computational or biomedical modeling.

  • Knowledge of drug delivery device design and pharmaceutical formulation considerations, including peptide and biologic delivery.

description:

Job Overview:


The VP, Data Intelligence Transformation is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining, building, and operationalizing the enterprise Data Intelligence strategy across LPL Financial's integrated data and AI engineering organization, LENSai. This role serves as the horizontal connector across enterprise data, analytics, AI, and distribution capabilities, establishing the operating model, architecture patterns, governance practices, and technical delivery required to transform governed enterprise data into trusted, reusable intelligence for analytics, reporting, applications, digital products, and AI experiences.


The role leads the development and adoption of the Cyan Intelligence Marketplace, enterprise semantic services, context management capabilities, and governed consumption patterns that enable scalable, secure, and observable access to trusted data assets. Working across Enterprise Data Lakehouse (EDLH), Data Warehousing & Automation (DWA), Data Modernization & Sharing (DMS), AI Engineering (AIE), and Data eXperience & Analytics (DXA), this leader drives alignment, integration, and measurable business outcomes while operating without direct ownership of the underlying engineering platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Data Intelligence operating model, including ownership frameworks, lifecycle practices, governance standards, intake processes, prioritization mechanisms, and delivery models.

  • Establish and evolve the Cyan Intelligence Marketplace as the enterprise discovery and consumption layer for trusted data products, semantic assets, metadata, context services, APIs, and governed access capabilities.

  • Lead strategy and technical delivery for enterprise semantic and contextual intelligence services that provide consistent business meaning across analytics, reporting, applications, digital experiences, and AI solutions.

  • Drive implementation of marketplace capabilities supporting data distribution, API enablement, MCP development, governed MCP access, and additional consumer access channels.

  • Create an integrated data value lifecycle that connects foundational data platforms, curated assets, semantic services, context management, distribution mechanisms, and consumer-facing experiences.

  • Establish enterprise standards and technical patterns for APIs, events, data sharing, semantic access, and MCP-based consumption, including associated controls, operational expectations, and delivery practices.

  • Drive consistency across key business domains by partnering with data owners and engineering teams to resolve data definition, lineage, mastering, reference data, and source-of-truth decisions.

  • Develop performance measures and operating mechanisms that monitor reuse, trust, consumer adoption, time-to-consumption, and business value realization.

  • Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and vendor solutions that support semantic, context, metadata, data consumption, integration, and intelligence marketplace objectives.

We are seeking a strategic and technically accomplished enterprise leader who can connect complex data, analytics, and AI capabilities into a cohesive business outcome. The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to pursue greatness through transformative thinking, act with integrity when making governance and technology decisions, remain driven to help our clients succeed by enabling trusted and scalable data consumption, win together through cross-functional influence and collaboration, and create and share joy by fostering alignment, simplification, and measurable impact across the organization.

Preferences:

title: Customer Relationship Specialist - Noosa
description:
About the Role

As a Customer Relationship Specialist, you’ll be the welcoming face of BOQ in our Noosa branch.


You’ll work closely with the Branch Manager and a supportive team to deliver exceptional service by identifying and responding to customers’ financial needs.

Your day-to-day will involve engaging customers in meaningful conversations to uncover their current and future goals, then matching them with the right banking solutions. You’ll manage loan maintenance requests such as top-ups, pricing adjustments, and variations, ensuring a smooth and transparent experience for the customer.

You’ll also play a key role in identifying opportunities for referrals to specialist teams, including Home Lending and Business Banking, to ensure customers receive the most comprehensive support. As part of your proactive rhythm, you’ll maintain regular contact with new and existing customers, manage leads, and book appointments to deepen relationships and drive retention.

In addition to customer-facing responsibilities, you’ll support the development of your team by coaching Customer Service Officers on quality conversations, lead identification, and service excellence.

You’ll also champion digital banking tools, helping customers build confidence in managing their finances online.

This role is a launchpad for a future in lending, with structured training in lending fundamentals and a clear pathway toward becoming a Lending Specialist.

About You

You’re a confident communicator with a genuine passion for helping people.

You’ll thrive in this role bringing previous experience in customer service, ideally within banking or financial services. Exposure to consumer lending is a plus.

You approach challenges with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and a “can-do” attitude.

Your attention to detail and ability to navigate financial systems with ease will help you succeed, along with a collaborative spirit and a drive to go above and beyond for customers and colleagues.

Most importantly, you’ll be part of a transformation journey that’s reshaping the future of banking.

If you're ready to dive in and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

About us

BOQ Group is a truly unique group of challenger brands with a purpose – to provide a genuine alternative to Australian financial services for customers and employees.

Our family of brands (Bank of Queensland (BOQ), ME Bank, Virgin Money Australia, BOQ Specialist), each come with their own defined customer audience and brand personality, but share one goal – to build social capital through banking. That’s creating trust with customers, exploring staff potential and believing that tiny gestures and big ideas can change the world for communities.

BOQ Group’s inclusive vision is to foster a workspace that values and leverages difference and creates new possibilities, a place where our people feel confident to bring their best selves to work every day. We embrace difference and believe that our workforce should reflect the customers and communities that we serve.

In 2023, we successfully implemented an innovative Reconciliation Plan, driving positive change and promoting inclusivity across BOQ Group.

Our perks

At BOQ Group, we are passionate about creating an exceptional work environment that nurtures both your professional and personal growth.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance your well-being, provide financial security, and foster a sense of community and inclusion. Here are just some of the fantastic perks you can enjoy as part of our team:

  • Flexible working arrangement - Balance your work and personal life with ease.

  • Discounted financial products - Enjoy exclusive rates on our financial services across the Group.

  • Salary sacrificing options - Maximise your take-home pay with our salary packaging options.

  • Paid parental leave with no minimum requirements - Spend quality time with your new family member without any worries.

  • Purchase additional annual leave - Need more time off? You can buy extra leave days.

  • Discounted private health insurance plan - Take care of your health with our special rates.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access confidential support for personal and professional challenges for you and your family

  • Access to employee network groups - Connect with peers through our First Nations Reconciliation, LGBTQIA+, Multicultural, Gender, Early Careers, and accessibility groups.

  • Pride in Diversity membership: We are proud members of Pride in Diversity and actively participate in the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Join us and be part of a company that truly cares about its people and community!

How to apply

To apply for this role, follow the links.

BOQ Group is committed to diversity and an inclusive workforce. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People are encouraged to apply.

We celebrate, value and include people of all backgrounds, gender and expressions, sexualities, cultures, bodies and abilities. When you apply, you are welcome to tell us the pronouns you use and please let us know any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

If you are successful for a role with BOQ Group, it is a condition of employment that background screening is completed to ensure that the Bank complies with its obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act. These checks may include, but are not limited to identity, verification, reference checks, criminal background checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications, bankruptcy checks.

Please no agency applications.

title: Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach - EOI (South West London)
description:
We are on a mission to be the partner of choice for developing people and their communities. Reed Wellbeing is a public service provider delivering lifestyle and wellbeing programmes that help people improve their health.

Pay Range

£50 per 90-minute session.

Job Description

Are you passionate about helping people to lead healthier lives?

Are you an enthusiastic, experienced health professional, looking for a flexible & highly rewarding role?

Then consider joining Reed Wellbeing as a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach!

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

This role will deliver across one or more programmes that make up the NHS Healthier You service. These programmes include the Diabetes Prevention Programme (DPP), Type 2 Diabetes Pathway to Remission Programme (T2DR), Behavioural Support for Obesity Prescribing Programme (BSOP) and Long-Term Conditions Prevention Pilot (LTCP).

As a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach, you will be responsible for the engagement and delivery of sessions in both group and/or one-to-one settings with participants.

Sessions are delivered face-to-face across South West London, therefore flexibility and a willingness to travel are essential. Applicants must also have access to their own vehicle and hold a full UK driving licence.

Expected availability for programme delivery is between 12 and 20 hours per week. In return, you will receive £50 per 90 Minute session.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver engaging NHS Healthier You Programme sessions to participants in a group and/or one-to-one setting, in accordance with our curriculum, resources and quality standards.

  • Motivate, support, and empower participants to make sustainable lifestyle and behaviour changes, using evidence-based coaching techniques to improve their overall health and wellbeing.

  • Adapt session delivery to meet the diverse needs, abilities, and learning styles of participants, and create a positive and inclusive environment to encourage participation.

  • Monitor participant progress, conduct regular revies, and celebrate achievements while identifying additional support needs.

  • Signpost participants to appropriate local health, wellbeing and lifestyle support services where required.

  • Participate in training, professional development, and quality improvement activities to ensure the highest standards of service delivery.

  • Contribute ideas and feedback to support continuous improvement of programme delivery and participant outcomes.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Qualifications:

  • Minimum Level 3 qualification in Exercise Referral, Health Improvement/Promotion/Public Health, Nutrition & Weight Management, Coaching & Behaviour Change, or Education & Training.

  • Evidence of training, qualification, or assessed competence in behaviour change delivery, aligned with recognised frameworks (e.g. COM‑B, Behaviour Change Wheel, motivational interviewing or health coaching approaches).

  • Fully First Aid trained, with a valid certificate.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Experience facilitating groups and supporting individuals to achieve positive health, lifestyle, or behaviour changes.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a person-centred and non-judgemental approach.

  • Ability to engage and motivate people from diverse backgrounds and with varying levels of confidence and health literacy.

  • Demonstrable IT skills, including the ability to confidently use digital platforms and systems to deliver services, record data, and meet reporting requirements.

  • Willingness to participate in induction, supervision, observed practice, competency assessment and ongoing CPD including all mandatory core training.

  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as required, and the ability to travel throughout the designated region using your own vehicle.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Experience delivering behaviour change programmes aligned with NHS‑commissioned or public health services.

  • Experience working with individuals and/or groups with additional needs, long-term health conditions, obesity, or pre-diabetes.

  • Fluency in multiple languages.

  • Experience supporting service users via digital or remote delivery platforms.

  • Qualification in group-based delivery.

  • Level 3 Qualification in British Sign Language.

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

title: Engineer (Winter 2026/Spring 2027 Graduates)
description:
The Role


The Engineer role is your opportunity to build a comprehensive understanding of our business from day one.


From formal training to mentorship, you’ll develop the technical skills, leadership instincts, and business acumen of seasoned experts. Atkinson’s network of companies spans every stage of construction, giving you room to explore, specialize, and grow.


The Engineer provides administrative and technical services in the fields of scheduling, cost engineering, subcontract coordination, and general project administration. Along with job site project managers and superintendents, engineers have responsibilities in overall project oversight and may be assigned to a particular section, subcontractor, or other facet(s) of the project.


Responsibilities


Your first few years with Atkinson will be defined by dynamic Career Building Experiences, where you will be exposed to:


Project Management: Working in project management gives you an understanding of the day-to-day and long-term business and financial management associated with construction projects.

  • Financial Management - Review gross billings, track change orders, and subcontractor requisitions
  • Document Control - Manage the submittals, RFI, and material tracking process
  • Support Crews and Trades - Stay ahead of the crew's needs, making sure they are efficient in their work

Field Management: Learn the intricacies of the building process, assist in site logistics, and ensure quality and safety on our job sites.

  • Quality Control and Safety - Monitor work with emphasis on quality and safety
  • Project Schedule - Assist with schedule management and site logistics
  • Critical Thinking - Resolve unforeseen challenges within installation, schedule, and coordination

Project Development: Understand how we acquire new work, develop winning strategies, and build strong client relationships through budgeting, estimating, and purchasing.

  • Budgeting - Review initial contract documents, solicit, and provide preliminary evaluations of subcontractor bids
  • Estimating - Perform quantity takeoffs, prepare the overall bid proposal, and quantify labor and material prices required for projects

Basic Qualifications

  • Pursuing an undergraduate degree (or equivalent) or a master's degree, with an expected graduation in Winter 2025 or Spring 2026
  • Interest and passion for the construction industry


What a Successful Candidate Looks Like


We look for individuals who embody these core principles:

  • Enthusiasm & Drive: Be punctual and dedicated, staying until work is done. Arrive early for meetings and events. Be a proactive team player – ask how you can help and be present. Take initiative, represent the company professionally (dress, demeanor), and build trust with your team, clients, and stakeholders. Proactively seek ways to contribute to team success and always maintain a positive attitude.
  • Delivery & Performance: Reliably meet the expectations of your role and commitments. Understand and follow Atkinson's standard procedures. Take on new responsibilities, dig into the details, and bring solutions to problems. Take ownership, be accountable, and demonstrate responsiveness with a sense of urgency.
  • Learning & Growth: Immerse yourself in Atkinson's culture, your team, and your community. Fulfill Atkinson Civil College learning requirements. Be engaged, accountable, and self-directed in your learning – be curious! Continuously build your technical expertise and grow your business acumen.

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.


The Physical Side of the Role: This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.


Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Atkinson Construction's safety policies and procedures and all applicable laws at all locations.


Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.


A Drug-Free Workplace: Atkinson promotes a drug-free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

Atkinson offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role, the base salary range is $77,500 - $95,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: Mountain Operations Technician - Giants Ridge
description:
Compensation Amount:

19.00 USD Hourly

Job Summary:

Mountain Operations Technicians support the safe and efficient operation of the mountain area throughout the year. This versatile, cross-trained position performs a variety of mountain operations duties, with responsibilities that may include snowmaking, grooming, trail maintenance, grounds maintenance, equipment operation, and special projects depending on the season and operational needs. This position works under the direction of the Mountain Manager and are expected to work safely, exercise sound judgment, and perform assigned duties independently in all weather conditions.

Job Description:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Operates a variety of equipment, vehicles, and machinery necessary to support mountain operations.
  • Performs daily pre-operational inspections, safety checks, fueling, and basic maintenance of assigned equipment.
  • Maintains accurate and complete records of equipment inspections, maintenance activities, and operational tasks.
  • Operates snow grooming equipment to build, shape, grade, and maintain skiing snowboarding surfaces.
  • Performs snowmaking operations, including setup, operation, monitoring, adjustment, maintenance, relocation, and shutdown of snowmaking equipment.
  • Monitors weather conditions, snow quality, and snow production and adjusts operations as necessary.
  • Assists with transporting, installing, and storing snowmaking equipment and infrastructure.
  • Performs trail slope, and grounds maintenance activities including mowing, brushing, trimming, erosion control, vegetation management, and debris removal.
  • Operates snowmobiles, ATVs/UTVs, and other equipment in support of daily mountain operations.
  • Assist with seasonal opening and closing procedures for ski slopes, trails, lift areas, and mountain facilities.
  • Identifies and report equipment deficiencies, safety concerns, operational issues, and unusual circumstances to management.
  • Supports special events and mountain projects as assigned.
  • Provides quality service to guests and works cooperatively with all departments.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, supervisors, and management.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

  • High School Diploma/G.E.D. equivalent required.
  • Must be at least 18 year of age.
  • Must possess a valid Class D driver's license.
  • Minimum of one year of heavy equipment operation experience preferred.
  • Ability to safely operate and maintain a variety of equipment and machinery.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions with limited supervision.
  • Mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills preferred.
  • Snowmaking, grooming, construction, landscaping, or equipment operation experience preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively and safely as part of a team in a fast-paced outdoor environment.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to perform a wide variety of physical activities in an alpine environment, including walking on uneven terrain, climbing, kneeling, squatting, bending, and lifting.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions and temperature extremes.
  • Ability to work overnights shits, weekends, holidays, and overtimes as operational needs require.
  • Ability to safely operate snowcats, snowmobiles, ATVs/UTVs, and other equipment on various terrain.
  • Ability to lift, carry, and push up to 35 pounds regularly, 50 pounds frequently, and 70 pounds or more occasionally.
  • Ability to enter and exit equipment repeatedly throughout a shift.
  • Skiing or snowboarding ability preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with guests, coworkers, and supervisors.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and adapt to changing operational needs.
  • Regular and reliable attendance and physical presence at the worksite are essential functions of the position.

EQUIPMENT USED

  • Snowcats/Grooming Machines
  • Snowmaking Equipment
  • Snowmobiles
  • Skid Loaders
  • Wheel Loaders
  • Excavators
  • ATVs/UTVs
  • Mowers and Brush-Cutting Equipment
  • Chainsaws and Power Saws
  • Hand and Power Tools

Like working outdoors, operating equipment, and having a job where no two seasons look quite the same? Join our Mountain Operations team and play a hands-on role in keeping the mountain ready for adventure year-round.


As a Mountain Operations Technician, you’ll be part of a versatile, cross-trained team that tackles everything from snowmaking and grooming in the winter to train and grounds maintenance, equipment operation, and mountain projects throughout the rest of the year. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with equipment, solving problems, and taking pride in seeing the results of their work across the mountain.


What We’re Looking For:

  • At least 18 years of age with a valid Class D driver’s license.
  • Mechanical aptitude and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Snowmaking, grooming, constructions, landscaping, or equipment operation experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
  • Flexibility to work overnight shifts, weekends, holidays, and overtime when mountain operations require it.
  • Skiing or snowboarding ability is a plus.

Why Work at Giants Ridge?

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Stay covered with medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, plus access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for additional support. We also offer HSAs, FSAs and more to help you manage healthcare costs.
  • Retirement Savings – Play for your future with our 401(k) retirement plan, featuring a company match to help you build financial security.
  • Paid Time Off – Take time to rest, relax and recharge with generous PTO.
  • Mountain Perks – Enjoy free employee passes and discounts for your family so you can hit the slopes and trails all season long!
  • Exclusive Golf Privileges – Hit the greens with complimentary golfing at our two championship golf courses.
  • Exclusive Discounts – Save on delicious food, stylish apparel and must-have accessories while working at Giants Ridge.
  • Work with Friends – Join a fun, supportive team where every day feels like an adventure.
  • Flexible Scheduling – We offer flexible schedules to fit your lifestyle, but some evening, weekend and holiday shifts are required to keep up with the excitement at Giants Ridge.
  • And More! – Additional perks and surprises that make Giants Ridge a great place to work!

Giants Ridge is the #1-rated family vacation destination in Minnesota. Located just north of Duluth in the heart of Minnesota’s Superior National Forest, Giants Ridge is a four-season, family-oriented resort offering fun and adventure for every level of outdoor enthusiast. Summer features world-class golf and lift-served mountain biking, while winter brings incredible skiing, snowboarding, fat tire biking, and more. Guests and employees alike can enjoy the Pool & Sauna Haus, along with dining, lodging, and a variety of year-round recreational amenities. Employees also have access to discounted lesson opportunities to help them develop new skills and make the most of the Giants Ridge experience. Beyond the resort, the Iron Range region offers abundant outdoor recreation, including lakes and waterways for boating, fishing, and paddling, as well as extensive trail networks for hiking, snowmobiling, and other seasonal activities. Spring and fall provide the perfect transition between seasons, showcasing the natural beauty and outdoor adventures that make the region a great place to live, work, and play.

title: Lead, AI
description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble Health Partners India!


Ensemble Health Partners - The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long-standing presence in technology. Leveraging our platform of services, technology, business intelligence and analytics, our teams are creating and maintaining innovative products and systems to help our revenue cycle operators achieve the most efficient, ideal outcomes for our clients. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end-to-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.


The Opportunity:


Job Role:

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to build, evaluate, and continuously improve clinical AI agents and supervised ML Models. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, LLM systems, evaluation, model improvement, and deep healthcare workflow understanding.


Your job is to turn frontier model capability into reliable production behavior: agents that read complex medical records, use the right clinical and coding context, call the right tools, produce auditable outputs, and improve from real-world failures.


You will be embedded in hard healthcare problems, clinical documentation integrity, medical coding, denial prevention, appeals, revenue cycle workflows, and payer logic — and will own the loop from problem framing to agent design, evaluation, deployment, trace analysis, and ongoing improvement.


The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who thinks like an applied scientist: rigorous about measurement, comfortable with ambiguity, excited by messy real-world data, and motivated by closing the gap between impressive demos and dependable production systems.


Most AI roles are either too research-heavy or too product-light. This role sits in the middle. You will not only write prompts or run experiments. You will own whether an agent actually works in production. That means understanding the workflow, designing the system, building the evals, inspecting failures, improving the agent, and proving that the improvement matters.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve production AI systems for complex healthcare workflows, including documentation, coding, denial management, appeals, and revenue cycle automation.
  • Prototype new AI capabilities from 0 to 1, then harden them into reliable, explainable, auditable production systems with clear contracts, monitoring, evidence, and performance gates.
  • Build rigorous evaluation and feedback loops using expert review, production logs, model outputs, and benchmarks to measure performance, regressions, reliability, cost, and business impact.
  • Own outcomes end to end: understand the workflow, design the system, inspect failures, improve the system, and prove that the improvement matters.
  • Set technical direction for a portfolio of projects, review designs, and mentor engineers as a technical lead.
  • Partner with research, ML engineering, platform, and product teams on model selection, training, infrastructure, and Productionalization.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field is a plus.

Industry Experience

  • 5-10 years of Applied Research, ML engineering, research engineering, software engineering, or applied AI experience.
  • A track record of shipping and operating production systems, ideally in ambiguous, high-stakes domains.
  • Prior experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or other regulated industries is a plus, not a requirement.

Why Choose Ensemble India?

People First, Last + Always

We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.


A Place to Thrive

Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.


Comprehensive Total Rewards

We support the physical, emotional and financial well-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:

• Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents

• Paid time off plans

• Retirement benefits

• Recognition and wellness programs

• Market competitive pay rates


Inclusive Culture

Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.


Purpose-Driven Impact

We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.


Ensemble Health Partners is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble Health Partners also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

At Novonesis, we use biology to transform how the world produces food, beverages, household products, renewable fuels, and more. As a Manufacturing Operations Intern, you will join our manufacturing team, where innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement drive operational excellence.


This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a production environment while supporting equipment performance and manufacturing operations. You'll work on real-world projects involving equipment investigations, mechanical troubleshooting, technical documentation, and engineering analysis while learning how manufacturing systems support the future of biotechnology.

You will gain exposure to manufacturing processes while helping identify solutions that improve operational performance and equipment effectiveness.

  • Support investigations related to equipment performance, reliability, and manufacturing process improvements.

  • Assist with identifying replacement parts, equipment specifications, and component compatibility.
  • Participate in root cause investigations and corrective action activities for equipment-related issues.
  • Collaborate with production, maintenance, engineering, and reliability teams to improve manufacturing performance.
  • Support continuous improvement projects focused on safety, quality, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Develop and update technical documentation, procedures, reports, and equipment records.
  • Present project findings, recommendations, and outcomes to site leadership when applicable.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals, and technical documentation.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Meaningful projects that contribute to operational performance and manufacturing excellence.

About Us

The North Carolina Department of Natural and Cultural Resources (DNCR) enriches people’s lives through education and stewardship of North Carolina’s natural and cultural resources. DNCR manages over 100 locations across the state, including historic sites, museums, state parks, trails, aquariums, the North Carolina Zoo, the Library of North Carolina, the State Archives, the North Carolina Arts Council, the African American Heritage Commission, the American Indian Heritage Commission, the State Historic Preservation Office, the Office of State Archaeology, the Highway Historical Markers program, the North Carolina Land and Water Fund, and the Natural Heritage Program. These programs and places unite North Carolinians, create a shared identity, and provide common ground. For more information, please visit www.dncr.nc.gov. We encourage you to apply to become a part of our team.


Description of Work

Do you enjoy our state parks and want to be a part of planning the future of the North Carolina State Park system? The NC State Parks is seeking a State Parks Planner to join the planning program team and develop master plans, general management plans, concept plans, graphically conveying ideas and decisions needed to improve or expand park facilities for visitor use, staff operations and preservation of natural resources.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:
· Preparing and updating general management plans.
· Preparing and updating master plans, conceptual plans and site plans for new and existing units.
· Supervise/coordinate contracted planning services for new and existing units.
· Coordinating with other programs throughout the Division and with external interested parties on park plans.
· Conducting comprehensive, long-range planning for the State Parks System, including preparation of the Systemwide Plan.
· Developing master plans, general management plans, concept plans, graphically conveying ideas and decisions needed to improve or expand park facilities for visitor use, staff operations and preservation of natural resources.
· Supervise temporary and permanent employees, volunteers, interns and consultants.
· Assist the Park Planning Program Manager in the preparation of other special planning projects, as needed.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences
